anodyne : nōyāṟṟum maruntu (aṉōṭaiṉ) valiyakaṟṟi; vali nīkki : valimai nīkkum oruvakai maruntu.

anogenital : kutam-piṟappuṟuppu maṇṭalam : kutam, piṟappuṟuppu maṇṭalam toṭarpāṉa.

anomaly : muṟai tiṟampiya; māṟi ceṟi vilakal : iyalpu nilaiyiliruntu māṟupaṭṭa allatu vēṟupaṭṭa allatu iyalpu tiṟampiya.

anomia : peyar maṟati nōy : poruḷkaḷiṉ allatu āṭkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷaik kūṟa muṭiyāta nilai.

anomie : taṉimaiyil vāḻpavar : maṟṟavarkaḷuṭaṉ toṭarpu koḷḷa muṭiyāta nilaiyil maṟṟavarkaḷuṭaṉ iṇaintu vāḻa muṭiyāta kāraṇattāl taṉimaiyil vāḻu oru napar.

anonychia : nakamiṉmai : nakaṅkaḷ illātiruttal.

anoperineal : kutam-eruvāy maṇṭalam : kutam, viraip paikkum eruvāykkum iṭaip pakuti ākiyavai toṭarpāṉa maṇṭalam.

anopheles : malēriyāk kocu; muṟaik kāyccal kocu : muṟaikkāyccalai (malēriyā) uṇṭākkum oruvakaik kocu iṉam. intak koka iṉattiṉ peṇkocukkaḷ kaṭippatāl maṉitarukku muṟaikkāyccal uṇṭākiṟatu.

anoplasty : kuta aṟuvaic maruttuvam : kutattil aṟuvai marut tuvam ceytu nōyaik kuṇappaṭuttum muṟai.

anorchism : viraiyiṉmai; kāyiṉmai : oruvarukku oṉṟu allatu iraṇṭu viraikaḷum piṟaviyilēyē illātiruttal.

anorectal : kutavāy toṭarpāṉa nōy : kutam, kutavāy toṭar pāṉa veṭippu nōy.

anorectic : paciyiṉmai; paci taṇippi; paciyaṭakki; pacikuṟaippi : (1) uṇavu uṇpatil viruppam illātiruttal nōy. (2) paci yiṉmai nōyāl avatiyuruvar.

anorexia (anorexia nervosa) : paciyiṉmai nōy; paciyāmai nōy : perumpālum kumarap paruvap peṇkaḷaip pīṭikkum oru cikkalāṉa uḷaviyal nōy. uṭal paruttuviṭumō eṉṟa accattil iḷam peṇkaḷ mikak kuṟaivāka uṇavu uṇpataip paḻakkamākkik koḷḷumpōtu intap paḻakkam or uḷaviyal nōyāka māṟi uṇavu uṇpatil veṟuppai uṇṭākkiviṭukiṟatu. itaṉai 'olliyāvataṟku aṭimaiyātal” eṉṟum kūṟalām. innōy kaṇṭavarkaḷukku eṭai kuṟaikiṟatu; uṭal eṭai kuṟaintālum uṭal kuṇṭākiṟatu eṉṉum accavuṇarvu tīviramaṭaikiṟatu. uṭal melital, iyalpukkumīṟi mātaviṭāy varātupōtal, malaccikkal, kāl vīkkam ākiyavai ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. attuṭaṉ mikak kuṟukiya kālattil peruntīṉi uṇṇum perum vēṭkaiyum uṇṭākiṟatu. uṇavu uṭ koḷvatu kuṟaintukoṇṭē varuvatāl iṟutiyil maraṇam viḷaikiṟatu.

anosmia : mukarvuṇarviḻappu; mukarvuṇarviṉmai; mōppa uṇarviṉmai; mukariṉmai : mukarum uṇarvai iḻantu viṭutal.

anovular : karuvaḷarcciyiṉmai; muṭṭaiyiṉmai; cūḻaṟṟa : karuttaṭai māttiraikaḷai uṭkoḷvatāl peṇkaḷiṭam karuvuṟutaliṉṟi mātaviṭāy uṇṭākiṟatu. itaṉāl irattap pōkku atikamākum.

anoxaemia : kuruti ākcijaṉ kuṟaipāṭu; uyirvaḷikkuṟai kuruti : irattattil ākcijaṉ illātiruttal.

anoxia : ticu ākcijaṉ kuṟai pāṭu; uyiriyamiṉmai; uyiriya muṭakkam : irattattil allatu ticukkaḷil ākcijaṉ pōtiya aḷavu illātu iruttal.

ansiline : aṉciliṉ : nilakkariyiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum eṇṇeyp pacaiyuḷḷa oru kūṭṭup poruḷ. itu nōy nuṇmattaṭaiccāyam tayārikkap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

antacid : puḷippu nīkka maruntu; amila etirppi; amila muṟi : vayiṟṟil puḷippai akaṟṟum maruntu, kāṭit taṉmaikku etirīṭāṉa allatu māṟṟāṉa maruntu. kārattaṉmaiyuṭaiya vayiṟṟuvali nīkkat tūḷ kalavai maruntukaḷil payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

antagonism : etirpput taṉmai; etirppiyal : cila maruntukaḷil uḷḷa tīviramāṉa etirpput taṉmai, (e-ṭu) "nākcōlōṉ" eṉṟa maruntu, mayakka maruntukaḷiṉ aṉaittu viḷaivukaḷaiyum etirmāṟākkukiṟatu. cilavakait tacaikaḷukkum, uṟuppukaḷukkuṅkūṭa inta etirpput taṉmai uṇṭu.

antaphrodisiac : ciṟṟiṉpam taṇikkum maruntu.

antazoline : etirviḻuppup poruḷ : ovvāmaikku etirppu maruntu. hisṭamiṉ eṉum poruḷukku etirpporuḷkaḷil oṉṟu.

antecedent : muṉṉōṭi;muṉṉikaḻcci; muṉceyal; muṉviṉai : oru kuṟippiṭṭa ceyalukku muṉṉatākavē naṭakkiṉṟa.

anteflexion : uṟuppu muṉ vaḷaittal; muṉmaṭakkam : karuppaiyiṉ nilaiyiliruntu potuvāka muṉṉōkki vaḷaintirukkum or uṟuppu.

ante-mortem : maraṇattiṟku muntiya; iṟakku muṉ; marikku muṉ : maraṇattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa nilai.

antenatal : pēṟukālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa; muṉpēṟṟu; karukkālam; pēṟṟu muṉnilai : piḷḷaip pēṟṟukku muntiya nilai.

antenna : uṇarkompu : pūcci vakaiyil muṉ taraiyiṉ iru pakkaṅkaḷil kāṇappṭum uṇarcci uṟuppu.

antepar : āṉṭippār : paipparacīṉ aṭaṅkiya nīrmam allatu māttirai.

antepartal : muṉ kuḻanṭaip pēṟṟuk kālam : kuḻantaip pēṟṟukku muṉpu kuḻantai piṟappataṟku muṉpu naṭakkiṉṟa.

antepartum : piṟappukku muṉ; makappēṟṟukku muṉ; piṟappu muṉ nilai :potuvāka niṟaimāta makappēṟṟukku muntiya 4 mātaṅkaḷ. atāvatu, 6ām mātam mutal 9ām mātam varai.

anterior : muṉpuṟam, muṉpakkam, muntaiya : (1) kālattāl muṟpaṭṭa (2) iṭattiṉ muṉṉatāka, (3) uṭaliṉ muṉ pakkam.

anterior chamber : viḻimuṉṉaṟai : paṉippaṭalattiṟkum (kaṇmaṇi allatu pāppā) viḻik karumpaṭalattiṟkum iṭaippaṭṭa viḻiyaṟai.

anterior horncells : taṇṭuvaṭa muṉ kompu aṇukkaḷ : taṇṭu vaṭa muṉkompil kāṇappaṭum narampaṇukkaḷ. inta aṇukkaḷiliruntu piriyum narampuyiḻaikaḷ elumput tacaikkaḷukkuḷ cellum.

anterolateral : muṉpakkavāṭṭil : muṉpakkamākavum atē nērat til uṭaliṉ mattiya pākattiliruntu vilakiyum iruttal. anteversion : muṉṉōkkic cāyvu; muṉcāyvu : uṭaliṉ or uṟuppu allatu pakuti muṉṉōkkic cāyntō iṭam peyarntō iruttal.

anthema : 'tōl peruṅ koppuḷam': toṭarpuṭaiya or iṇaippuccol. (e-ṭu) (enanthema) caḷippaṭalak koppuḷam.

anthelmintic : kuṭaṟpuḻu nīkka maruntu; puḻuppakai; pūccik kolli ; kuṭaṟpuḻu maruntu : kuṭaliluḷḷa puḻukkaḷai veḷiyēṟṟukiṟa allatu oḻikkiṟa oru maruntu.

antheroselerosis : taṉimattuṭippu.

anthiphen : āntiḵpṉ : meppirāmiṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

anthracene : āntaraciṉ : kari maṟṟum tār ivaṟṟiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum oru vakai haiṭrō-kārpaṉ. cāyam tayārippataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

anthracoid : tōṟṟattil irāja piḷavai pōlirukkiṉṟaṉa.

anthracosis : nuraiyīral nōy; nuraiyīral karippaṭivu; karimanōy : nilakkarit tūḷ kalanta kāṟṟai uṭkoḷvatāl uṇṭākum nuraiyīralil kārpaṉ cērntu uṇṭākum nōy.

anthracycline : āntiracaikḷiṉ : puṟṟunōykkut tarappaṭum oru vakai nuṇṇuyirk kolli. ṭāṉāmaiciṉ maṟṟum ṭākcō rupiciṉ kalanta maruntu.

anthraquinone : āntirakuyiṉōṉ : āntiracīṉiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum kuyiṉōṉ vakai maruntu. cāyam tayārippataṟkup payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

anthrax : naccup paru : kālnaṭaikaḷukku uṇṭākum āpattāṉa naccuc cīḻ kaṭṭu nōy. itu oru toṟṟu nōy. itu kālnaṭai kaḷiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkum toṟṟakkūṭum

naccup paru

anthropoid : curuṅkiya iṭuppelumpu : iṭuppu vaḷaiyam pakkattukkup pakkam kuṟukic curuṅkiyuḷḷa iṭuppuk kūṭu.

anthropology : māṉuṭaviyal; māntaviyal : maṉitakulattaip paṟṟi ārāyum tuṟai. itil pala pirivukaḷ uṇṭu.

anthropometry : maṉita uṭal aḷavai; uṭal aḷavi, māṉiṭa nilai aḷavi : maṉitariṉ uṭal, ataṉ uṟuppukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟiṉ aḷavai. oppīṭu ceyvataṟ kākavum, pāliṉam, vayatu, eṭai, iṉam pōṉṟavaṟṟukkāṉa uru mātirikaḷai vakuppataṟkākavum inta aḷavai payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

antiadrenergic : naramputtūṇṭal camaṉamākkal : parivu narampu maṇṭalattiṉ narampu iḻaikaḷiṉāl uṇṭākum tūṇṭu viḷaivukaḷaic camaṉappaṭuttutal allatu kuṟaittal.

antiallergic : ovvāmaittaṭuppu; māṟṟu viṉaippakai : ovvā maiyait taṭuttal; kuṟaittal.

antiamoebic : amīpākkolli : amīpā kirumikaḷ vaḷarvataiyum, perukuvataiyum taṭukkiṉṟa allatu avaṟṟai aḻikkiṉṟa maruntu. -

antianabolic : purataccērmam taṭuppu : uṭal puratattiṉ kūṭ ṭiṇaivait taṭuttal.

antianaemic : kurutip pōkku taṭuppu maruntu; cōkai etirppi : kurutikkuḻāykaḷiliruntu irattam veḷippaṭuvatait taṭukkap payaṉpaṭum maruntu. (e-ṭu) vaiṭṭamiṉ K.

antianginal : itayavali maruntu; neñcuvali maruntu : itayat tacaikaḷukkuc celkiṉṟa iratta aḷavai atikarittum, itayappaṇi aḷavaik kuṟaittum itaya valiyaip pōkkukiṉṟa maruntu.

antiarrhythmic : itaya cīr māṟiya tuṭippu maruttuvam : palvēṟu itayattuṭippuk kōḷāṟukaḷaik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum maruntukaḷum, maruttuva muṟaikaḷum.

antibacterial : pākṭīriyā etirppu maruntu; nuṇṇuyiri muṟi; nōyaṇu muṟi : pākṭīriyākkaḷai aḻikkiṟa, avaṟṟiṉ vaḷarcciyait taṭukkiṟa oru maruntu.

anti beriberi : taviṭṭāṉ etirppu maruntu : ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟai viṉāl uṇṭākum taviṭṭāṉ eṉṟa nōykku etirāṉa maruntu. eṭuttukkāṭṭu : vaiṭṭamiṉ B kalaiaivayiluḷḷa taiyāmiṉ.

antibiosis : uṭaṉvāḻ ovvāmai etir uyirikaḷ; uyirp pakaimai: or uyiriṉ iyalpāṉa vāḻkkai viḷaivāṉa poruḷ, maṟṟōr iṉa uyiriṉ vaḷarccikkuk kēṭāka irukkum taṉmai.

antibiotic : nōymuṟiyam.

antibiotics : nōy nuṇma etirppup poruḷkaḷ; uyirk kolli; nuṇṇuyirkkolli; nōymuṟiyam : pūñcaṇam, pākṭīriyā pōṉṟavaṟṟiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum nōyk kirumi etirppup poruḷkaḷ. peṉciliṉ itaṟku or eṭuttukkāṭṭu. piṉṉar kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭa ṭeṭrācaikḷiṉ pōṉṟa tacainōy uṇṭākkum uyirikaḷukku etirākat tiṟampaṭa vēlai ceykiṉṟaṉa; ivaṟṟai vāyvaḻiyākavum koṭukkalām. niyōmaiciṉ, pāciṭrāciṉ pōṉṟavai atika naccut taṉmaiyuṭaiyaṉavāka iruppatāl, uḷḷē payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuvatillai, puṟakāyaṅkaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antibody : nōy etirpporuḷ; viḷai etirmam; taṟkāppu mūlam : tīṅkutarum ayaṟporuḷukku etirāka uyiriṉattiṉ uṭalil uṇṭākum poruḷ.

anticholinergic : pittanīr narampuk kōḷāṟu : pittanīr narampu, aciṭṭilkōliṉ eṉṟa oru vētiyiyal poruḷiṉ mūlamākat taṉatu tuṇṭalkaḷai narampu allatu itaya narampuc cantippukaḷukku aṉuppukiṟatu. inta naṭavaṭikkaikkut taṭaiyāka irukkum ceyal.

anticlockwise : etivalam.

anticoagulant : kurutikkaṭṭut taṭaipporuḷ; uṟaivu etirppi : uṭalil kāyampaṭṭu irattam aḷavukku atikamāka veḷiyēṟi vīṇāvatait taṭuppataṟkāka, irattattai iṟuki uṟaiyac ceyyum poruḷ irattattil uḷḷatu. ivvāṟu irattam uṟaiyac ceyvatait taṭukkum poruḷ kurutikkaṭṭut taṭaipporuḷ ākum. nōyiyal paricōtaṉai kaḷukkāka irattam muḻuvataiyum eṭukka vēṇṭiyirukkumpōtu, ākcālik amilam (vellaka amilam) kurutikkaṭṭut taṭaipporuḷākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. irattam celuttuvataṟkāka irattam eṭukkumpōtu, cōṭiyam caiṭrēṭ kurutik kaṭṭut taṭaipporuḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

anticoagulation : irattam uṟaitalait taṭuttal; irattam uṟaiyāt taṉmai; kuruti uṟaiyā nilai.

anticonvulsant : valipput taṭaip poruḷ; valippaṭakki; valippu muṟi : valippai aṟavē oḻikkiṟa allatu taṭukkiṟa poruḷ.

antidepressants : cōrvu nīkka maruntukaḷ; uḷaccōrvup pōkkikaḷ : cōrviṉai akaṟṟukiṟa maruntukaḷ ṭiraicaikḷik kuḻumattaic cērnta maruntukaḷ itaṟkup perumaḷavil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. akaccōrvuk kōḷāṟukaḷukku ivai payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antidiarrhoeal : vayiṟṟuppōkkut taṭuppu maruntu : vayiṟṟuppōkkaik kuṟaikkiṉṟa maruntu vayiṟṟup pōkkai kuṇappaṭuttukiṉṟa maruntu. vayiṟṟuppōkku aṟikuṟikaḷai aṟavē pōkkukiṉṟa maruntu.

antidiabetic : nīriḻivu maruttuvam; carkkarai nōy etirppi; nīriḻi vaṭakki : nīriḻivu nōykku etirāṉa maruttuvac cikiccai muṟaikaḷai itu kuṟikkiṟatu. iyakkunīr kaṇaiyaccurappu nīr (iṉculiṉ) vāyvaḻi maruntukaḷ ākiyavai itil aṭaṅkum.

antiemetic : vāntittaṭuppāṉ; vānti maruntu : vānti maṟṟum umaṭṭalait taṭukkum maruntu, vānti maṟṟum umaṭṭaliliruntu nivāraṇam tarum maruntu.

antidiphtheritic : toṇṭai aḻaṟcit taṭuppu maruttuvam : toṇṭai aḻaṟci nōyait (ṭiptīriyā) taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruttuvam muṟaikaḷ toṟṟu nōyt taṭuppu naṭavaṭikkaikaḷ itil aṭaṅkum.

antidiuretic : ciṟunīrk kaḻivut taṭuppu maruttuvam; ciṟunīrkkuṟaippi; nīr perukkaṭakki : ciṟunīr aḷavukku mīṟik kaḻivatait taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruttuva muṟai.

antidote : māṟṟu maruntu; naccumuṟippi; naccu muṟi : naccup poruḷai muṟippataṟkuk koṭukkappaṭum māṟṟu maruntu. eṭuttuk kāṭṭāka amila nañciṉai muṟikka cōṭiyampaikkārpaṉēṭ taṭuppu maruntu pōṉṟa kārap poruṭkaḷaik koṭuttal.

anti-dysenteric : aḷaiccal taṭuppu maruntu : vayiṟṟaḷaiccalait taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruntu.

antiembolic : kurutik kuḻāyaṭaipput taṭuppu maruntu : pakka vātattiṟkuriya nilaiyil kurutik kuḻāykaḷil kurutik kaṭṭi vaḻiyaṭaippatait taṭukkum maruntu.

antiemetic : vāntit taṭuppu maruntu; vāntiyaṭakki : kumaṭṭa laiyum, vāntiyaiyum taṭukkum maruntu.

antienzyme : iyakkunīr taṭaipporuḷ; iyakku nīr etirppi :or iyakkunīr (eṉcaim) ceyaṟpaṭuvatait taṭukkum poruḷ. itu cīraṇamaṇṭalattil iruppatāl, nōyt taṭuppai etirkkiṟatu.

antiepileptic : valippu nōy taṭuppu maruntu; valippaṭakki maruntu : kākkāy valippu aṭikkaṭi varuvataik kuṟaikkum maruntu.

antifebrite : kāyccal taṭuppu maruntu; kāycalaṭakki : kāyccalait taṭukkum allatu kuṟaikkum maruntu.

antifebrin : kāyccal etirppu maruntu : kāyccalaik kuṇappaṭuttak koṭukkappaṭum aciṭṭāṉilaiṭu eṉṟa maruntu. itu aciṭṭik amilam, aṉiliṉ iraṇṭum kalantu peṟappaṭukiṟatu.

antifibrinolytic : ūnīrkōḷāṟu taṭuppu maruntu : kaṭṭiyāka uṟaiyak kūṭiya ūṉīr kacivuk kōḷāṟukaḷait taṭukkakkūṭiya maruntu.

antitungai : kāḷāṉ oḻippu maruntu; kāḷāṉ nīkkikaḷ; pūcaṇap pakai :nōyttaṉmaiyuṭaiya kāḷāṉ (nāykkuṭai) vakaiyai oḻikkum maruntu.

antigen : kāppu mūlam; uṭaṟ kāppu ūkki; viḷaiviyam : ayaṟ poruḷiliruntu uyiriṉam kākkum uyir taṟkāppup poruḷai uṇṭu paṇṇum poruḷ mūlam. itu irattattil uṟpattiyākum nōy etirp poruḷai uṇṭākkukiṟatu.

antihaemophilic globulin (AHG) : kurutipperukkut taṭuppup puratap poruḷ : irattakkaṭṭiyil aṭaṅkiyuḷḷa VIII. itu niṇa nīril uḷḷatu; kuruti niṇanīril illai. kurutip perukkil kuṟaivāka irukkiṟatu.

antihaemorrahgic : kurutippōkkut taṭaipporuḷ : kurutik kuḻāykaḷiliruntu irattam veḷippaṭuvatait taṭukkum poruḷ. itaṉai vaiṭṭamiṉ K eṉpar.

antihypertensive : uyar iratta aḻuttat taṭaipporuḷ; mikai aḻuttak kuṟaippi; pēraḻuttat taṇippi : uyarnta iratta aḻut tattaik kuṟaikkum oru poruḷ.

antiinfective : toṟṟut taṭaipporuḷ; toṟṟut taṭai : nōy toṟṟuvatait taṭukkum maruntu, itaṉai vaiṭṭamiṉ A eṉpar.

antiinflammatory : vīkkattaṭuppup poruḷ nīkki; aḻaṟcit taṭai : vīkkattaik kuṟaikkiṟa allatu vīkkam ēṟpaṭāmal taṭukkiṟa poruḷ.

antileprotic : toḻunōyt taṭuppu maruntu; toḻunōy etirppi; toḻunōyp pakai : toḻunōy ēṟpaṭāmal taṭukkiṟa allatu toḻunōyaik kuṇappaṭuttukiṟa oru maruntu.

antilymphocyte serum (ALS) : niṇanīr aṇu etirppu ūṉīr; paṭinīrccel etirc cīram : niṇa nīrkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷait taṭuttu avaṟṟaik kaṭṭiyākkukiṟa nōy etirppup poruḷkaḷaiyuṭaiya ūṉir.

antilysian: citaivu tṭaivi.

antilysis : citaivut taṭai.

antimetabolite : vaḷarcitai māṟṟat taṭuppup poruḷ; ūṉma ākkattaṭai : or uyiraṇuviṉ karumaiyap purataṅkaḷil oruṅ kiṇaittu ataṉ vaḷarcciyait taṭuppataṟkuk tēvaiyāṉa vētiyiyal poruḷkaḷai ottirukkum oru kūṭṭupporuḷ. itu puṟṟunōy maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antimicrobial : nuṇṇuyir etirppup poruḷ; nuṇṇuyirp pakai : uyir nuṇmaṅkaḷukku etirākac ceyaṟpaṭum poruḷ.

antimicrobic : nōy nuṇmat taṭai.

antimigraine : oṟṟait talaivalit taṭuppu maruntu : kaṭumaiyāṉa oṟṟait talaivaliyait taṭukkum maruntu.

antimitotic : uyiraṇup piḷavu iyakkattaṭuppu maruntu; ticuppiḷapput taṭai : uyiraṇu nuṇṉiḻaiyākap pirintu iṉapperukkam ceyvatait taṭukkum maruntu. puṟṟu nōyaik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa pala maruntu kaḷai itu kuṟikkum.

antimony and potassium tartrate : karunimiḷai maṟṟum poṭṭāciyam ṭārṭrēṭ : añcaṉakkal eṉappaṭum karunimiḷai (āṉṭimaṇi) poṭṭāciyam puḷiyakakkāṭiyiṉ uppuccattu aṭaṅkiya oru vakaip paḻaiya maruntu. itu ippōtu, veppa maṇṭala nōykaḷaik kuṇappaṭutta mukkiyamākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antimutagen : vakai māṟṟat taṭuppup poruḷ : uyiriṉavakai māṟṟa viṉaiyaip payaṉaṟṟatākkum oru poruḷ.

antimycotic : kāḷāṉ aḻippup poruḷ; kāḷāṉ nōy : nōy uṇṭākkum oṭṭuyirk kāḷāṉkaḷai aḻikkum oru maruntu.

antineoplastic : putu uyir ūṉma etirppup poruḷ : putiya uyir ūṉmaṅkaḷukku etirākac ceyaṟpaṭum oru poruḷ.

antinephritic : kuṇṭikkāy paṟṟiya; nōyk ketirākac ceyyappaṭukiṟa.

antineurtic : narampu nōyttaṭuppu maruntu; narampaḻaṟcit taṭai : narampu nōyait taṭukkum maruntu, itu kuṟippāka vaiṭṭamiṉ B kalavaiyaik kuṟikkum.

anti-oedema : vīkkat taṭai.

antiodontgic : palvali taṭukkum maruntu.

antioxidants : ākcikaraṇa etirppup poruḷ; ākciyēṟṟi etirppup poruḷ; uyir vaḷiyēṟṟa etirppikaḷ : ākcikaraṇa muṟaiyait tāmatappaṭuttum oru poruḷ.

antiparkison (ISM) drugs : pārkkiṉcaṉ nōyttaṭai maruntu : 'ḵpiṉōttiyāciṉ' pōṉṟa mukkiya camaṉappaṭuttum maruntukaḷ. ivai narampu cārnta allatu uḷaviyal cārnta nōykaḷaik kuṇappaṭuttum maruntukaḷiṉ pakka viḷaivukaḷait taṭukkap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antiparasitic : oṭṭuyir oḻippup poruḷ; oṭṭuṇṇi etiri; oṭṭuṇṇittaṭai : oṭṭuṇṇikaḷai allatu oṭṭuyirkaḷait taṭukkiṟa allatu aḻikkiṟa poruḷ.

antipellagra : tōl veṭippi nōyt taṭai maruntu : ūṭṭak kuṟaiviṉāl ēṟpaṭṭu, iṟutiyil mūḷaikkōḷāṟil koṇṭu viṭum tōlveṭippu nōyaik kuṇappaṭuttum maruntu. vaiṭṭamiṉ B kalavaiyiluḷḷa nikkōṭṭiṉik amilam eṉṟa pakuti ippaṇiyaic ceykiṟatu.

antiperiodic : kālāntara nōyt taṭuppu maruntu : kāyccal (malēriyā) pōṉṟa kālāntaraṅkaḷil tirumpat tirumpa varukiṟa nōykaḷait taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruntu.

antiperistalsis : tacaic curukka etir māṟṟu alai; etiralai viyakkam ; kuṭalalai etirppikaḷ kuṭal acaivu maṟinilai : uṇavu cāram eḷitil celluvataṟkicaivāṉa uṇarvaṟṟa vaṭṭākāramāṉa taṉṉiyakkat tacaic curukka alaikaḷiṉ iyalpāṉa iyakkattai etir māṟākkutal.

antiphlogistic : vīkkam taṇippi.

antiprothrombin : kurutikkaṭṭut taṭuppu : kuruti nāḷaṅkaḷil kuruti uṟaivatait taṭuttal.

antiprotozoal : muntu nuṇmattaṭai.

antipruritic : aripput taṭuppu maruntu; namaiccalaṭakki; arippuk kuṟaippi; namaiccuttaṭai : tōlil arippu ēṟpaṭuvataik kuṇap paṭuttum allatu taṭukkum maruntu.

antipurpura : cennīlap puḷḷit taṭuppu maruntu : tōliṉ mēl cennīla niṟappuḷḷikaḷ koṇṭa nōy ēṟpaṭuvatait taṭukkum maruntu. vaiṭṭamiṉ P intap paṇiyaic ceykiṟatu.

antipyretic : kāyccal kuṟaippāṉ maruntu; curamaṭakki; kāyccalaṭakki; curattaṭai : kuḻantaik kaṇai (rikkaṭs) nōyait taṭukkum maruntu. vaiṭṭamiṉ D ippaṇiyaic ceykiṟatu.

antirabic : nāykkaṭi nōyt taṭai.

antirachitic : elu citaivuttaṭai.

antiRhesus : uṟai ūkka etirppuk kūṟu : kurutiyil uṟaimam ūkkuṅkūṟu celuttappaṭum pōtu etircceyal kāṭṭukiṟa (Rh-positive) kuḻantai peṟukiṟa peṇkaḷukkup pintiya makappēṟṟiṉ pōtu karumūlattāḷ cavvil pātippu ēṟpaṭāmal taṭuppataṟkāka, kurutiyil uṟaimam ūkkuṅkaṟu cettappaṭum pōtu etircceyalkāṭṭāka (Rh-negative) kūṟu aḷikkappaṭutal.

antirheumatic: kīlvātat taṭuppu maruntu; mūṭṭuvalit taṭai; vātamaṭakki; muṭakku nōy taṭuppi; muṭakku nōy nīkki : kīlvātattait taṭukkakkūṭiya allatu kuṟaikkak kūṭiya maruntu.

antiscorbutic : coṟinōyt taṭuppu maruntu; mūkku vaṟaṭci nōy nīkki; kacinōyt taṭai : ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟaiviṉāl ēṟpaṭum coṟi, karappāṉ, pal ekir vīkka nōyait (skarvi) taṭukkiṟa allatu kuṇap paṭuttukiṟa maruntu. vaiṭṭamiṉ C intap paṇiyaic ceykiṟatu.

antiseptic : nōy nuṇmat taṭai maruntukaḷ; cīḻ etirppi; naccu nīkki; naccu nīkkuvi : nōykaḷai uṇṭākkum nuṇṇuyirkaḷai aḻikkiṟa allatu avaṟṟiṉ vaḷarcciyait taṭukkiṟa vētiyiyal poruḷkaḷ. ivai uyiruḷḷa ticukkaḷil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antithrombin : tirāmpiṉ taṭai; kurutiyuṟaivut taṭuppupporuḷ : irattattil iyaṟkaiyāka irukkum kurutiyuṟaivut taṭuppup poruḷ. (e-ṭu) heppāriṉ.

antrum : tāṭaik kuḻivu; kukaik kuḻivu; elumpuk kuḻiveṭṭu; elumpaṟai veṭṭukkuḻi puḻai : mēl tāṭai uḷvaḷaivu. itu paṟkaḷukku mēlē, neṟṟikkuḷḷē, kaṇkaḷukkuc caṟṟu mēlē kātiṉ piṉpuṟamuḷḷa elumpil amaintirukkum.

articulate : mūṭṭutal, mūṭṭal : 1. iru elumpukaḷ, acaivukku vaḻiviṭṭu iṇaital, 2. teḷivākap pēcakkūṭiya, 3. (ceyaṟkaip pal iṇaippait tayārikkum pōtum) paṟkaḷaic cariyākap poruttutal.

artificial pacemaker : itayat tuṭippaic cīrākkum karuvi : uṭalil oṭum irattattaic cuttappaṭutti, iratta ōṭṭattaic cīrpaṭuttuvatu itayam, itayattil mēlaṟaikaḷ iraṇṭum, kīḻaṟaikaḷ iraṇṭum uḷḷaṉa. acutta irattam mutalil iṭatu mēlaṟaikku vantu, aṅkiruntu iṭatu kīḻaṟaikkuc ceṉṟu, aṅkiruntu aḻuttappaṭṭu nuraiyīralukkuc ceṉṟu, aṅku ākcijaṉaip peṟṟuc cuttamaṭaikiṟatu. cuttamaṭainta irattam valatu mēlaṟaikku vantu, aṅkiruntu valatu kīḻaṟaikkuc ceṉṟu aṅkiruntu aḻuttappaṭṭu makātamaṉi vaḻiyāka uṭaliṉ maṟṟap pakutikaḷukkum celkiṟatu. mēlaṟaikaḷum, kīḻaṟaikaḷum cīrāṉa orē vēkattil iyaṅkumpōtu iratta oṭṭam cīrāka irukkum mēlaṟaikaḷum kīḻ aṟaikaḷum iyaṅkum vēkamē itayat tuṭippu. inta vēkattaic cīr paṭutta nam itayattil iyaṟkaiyākavē 'ciṉōṭriyal nōy' eṉṟa amaippu uḷḷatu. narampu uyiraṇukkaḷālāṉa intac ciṟiya taraip pakuti, iṭatu mēlaṟaic cuvaril uḷḷatu. itiliruntu eḻum tuṭippu, mēlaṟaikaḷum kīḻaṟaikaḷum orē cīrāka iyaṅka utavukiṟatu. itu cariyāka vēlai ceyyāta pōtu, itayattiṉ iratta oṭṭam pātittu, inta kōḷāṟaic cariceyya itayat tuṭippaic cīrākkum intac ceyaṟkaik karuvi poruttappaṭukiṟatu. itil, litiyam ayōṭiṉālāṉa miṉkalam uḷḷatu. itaṉ eṭai 40 kirām irukkum. mārpil itayam irukkum pakutiyiṉmītu ciṟiya aṟuvaiceytu ikkaruvi tacaip pakutikkuḷ vaikkap paṭukiṟatu. itiluḷḷa mika nuṇṇiya kampi (vayar) itayat tacaip pakutiyuṭaṉ iṇaikkappaṭukiṟatu. itiluḷḷa miṉkalam mūlam, kampi tuṇṭutal peṟṟu itayattuṭippaic cīrākkukiṟatu. ikkaruvi poruttappaṭṭa cila nāṭkaḷil nōyāḷiyiṉ itayam mīṇṭum cīrāka iyaṅkat toṭaṅkum. avvāṟu cīrāka iyaṅkat toṭaṅkiyatum ikkaruvi taṉ paṇiyai niṟuttik koḷḷum. mīṇṭum kōḷāṟu ēṟpaṭṭāl, ikkaruvi mīṇṭum tāṉākavē paṇiyait toṭaṅki viṭum. ikkaruvi 10 āṇṭukaḷ varai ceyaṟpaṭum.

blind sight : kuruṭṭup pārvai : pārvaikkuriya puṟaṇi cēta maṭaivatāl, cila nōyāḷikaḷ, vaḻakkamāṉa cōtaṉaikaḷukkup piṟaku, pārvaiyiḻantavarkaḷ eṉa aṟivikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉar. eṉiṉum, eñciyuḷḷa pārvaiyaip payaṉpaṭuttik koḷvataṟku avarkaḷukkup payiṟciyaḷikkalām.

blind spot : kuruṭṭup pakuti; kuruṭṭup poṭṭu, kuruṭṭup puḷḷi : viḻittiraiyiṉ kuruṭṭup pakuti. iṅku pārvai narampāṉatu, viḻittiraiyil iruntu vilakiviṭukiṟatu. itaṉāl, ippakutiyiṉāl oḷiyai uṇara iyalātu.

Blocadren : piḷākkāṭraṉ : ṭimōlālmāliyēṭ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

block : aṭaippu: taṭai.

blocking : uṇarvu taṭuttal.

blood : irattam; kuruti : itayattilum irattanāḷaṅkaḷilum niṟaintirukkum cenniṟa neypput taṉmaiyuṭaiya tiravam. itil, kurutinīr (piḷāsmā) eṉappaṭum uyirmap poruḷ aṭaṅkiyuḷḷatu. itil irattac civappaṇukkaḷ, iratta veḷḷaṇukkaḷ, takaṭṭu aṇukkaḷ mitakkiṉṟaṉa. kuruti nīril, irattam kaṭṭikkoḷḷa utavum poruḷkaḷ uṭpaṭap palvēṟu poruḷkaḷ karai calāka aṭaṅkiyuḷḷaṉa.

blood bank : iratta vaṅki; kuruti vaṅki : iratta tāṉam koṭup pōriṭamiruntu irattattai eṭuttu, ataṉait tēvaiyāṉavarkaḷukkuc celuttavatu varaiyil pātukāppākak kuḷirpataṉap peṭṭiyil cēmittu vaikkum nilaiyam.

bloodbrain barrier : iratta mūḷai vēli : cuṟṟōṭṭa irattattiṟkum mūḷaikkumiṭaiyilāṉa cavvup paṭalavēli. cila maruntukaḷ irattattil iruntu intat taṭaiyiṉ vaḻiyāka mūḷait taṇṭuvaṭa nīrukkuc cella muṭiyum. maṟṟavaṟṟāl muṭiyātu. eṭuttukkāṭṭu: sṭirapṭō maiciṉ.

blood casts : irattattuṇukkukaḷ : uṟaintupōṉa irattac civappaṇukkaḷiṉ tuṇukkukaḷ. ivai, ciṟunīrk kuḻāykaḷil uruvāki, ciṟunīril kāṇappaṭum.

blood clotting : irattakkaṭṭu; kuruti uṟaital : iratta nāḷaṅ kaḷil aṭaippu ēṟpaṭṭu iratta oṭṭam taṭaipaṭukiṟatu. nuṇṇiya taṭṭaṇukkaḷiṉ tukaḷ tiraṇṭu iratta nāḷac cuvarkaḷil uḷḷa 'kōlējaṉ' eṉṟa poruḷil oṭṭik koṇṭu, iṭaiveḷiyai aṭaittuviṭukiṉṟaṉa . potuvāka nāḷaccuvarkaḷil paṭintuḷḷa melliya uyiraṇup paṭalattiṉāl pāyum irattattil iruntu 'kōlējaṉ' pirikkappaṭukiṟatu. intap paṭalattil oru piḷavu ēṟpaṭum pōtutāṉ, kōlējaṉuṭaṉ irattattiṟkut toṭarpu uṇṭākiṟatu. ataṉāl taṭṭaṇuk kaḷ atil oṭṭik koḷkiṉṟaṉa. curuṅkutalum, aṭaippum kurutip pōkkukaḷil ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

blood culture : kuruti vaḷarppu; kuruti varaimai : oru nāḷattil iruntu irattam veḷiyēṟṟappaṭṭatum, peritum ukantatoru veppanilaiyil poruttamāṉatoru ūṭakattil irattam perukkamaṭaiyumāṟu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. itaṉāl uḷḷaṭaṅkiya uyirikaḷ perukkamaṭaiya muṭikiṟatu. inta uyirikaḷait taṉimaippaṭutti nuṇ ṇōkkāṭi mūlam aṭaiyāḷaṅ kāṇalām. blood count : kurutiyaṇu eṇṇikkai : kurutiyaṇu aḷavai māṉiyaip payaṉpaṭutti, irattattil oru milli mīṭṭaril ettaṉai civappaṇukkaḷ allatu veḷḷai aṇukkaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa eṉpataik kaṇakkiṭutal. itaṉ mūlam, irattattil civappu veḷḷai aṇukkaḷiṉ vīta aḷavu kaṇakkiṭap paṭukiṟatu. pālimārḵpas: 65%-70%; limppōcaiṭs: 20%-25% māṉōcaiṭs: 5%; īciṉōḵpil :0%-3%; pācōḵpils-0%- 0.5% kuḻantaip paruvattil limpōcaiṭṭukaḷiṉ vīta aḷavu atikamāka irukkum.

blood-dust : kurutiyiluḷḷa niṟamilā ciṟu tukaḷ.

blooded : kurutiyuṭaiya.

blood glucose profiles : kuruti carkkarai aḷavu : nīriḻivu nōyāḷikaḷiṉ irattattil uḷḷa carkkaraiyiṉ vīta aḷavaik kaṇṭaṟital. itu nīriḻivu nōyāḷikaḷukkuriya cikiccai aḷippataṟku utavukiṟatu. nīriḻivu nōyāḷiyiṉ iratta mātirikaḷ kālai uṇavukku muṉpum, kālai uṇavukku 2 maṇi nēram piṉpum, naṇpakal uṇavukku 2 maṇi nēram piṉpum, mālai uṇavukku muṉpum, iravu paṭukkaikkup pōkum nērattilum cila nōyāḷikaḷukku iravu nērattilum eṭukkappaṭṭuc carkkarai aḷavu kaṇakkiṭappaṭukiṟatu. itaṉ aṭippaṭaiyil nōyāḷikkuriya maruttuva muṟai tīrmāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.

blood group : kuruti pakuppiṉam; kuruti vakai; kuruti vakaiyaṟital : kurutiyiṉ nāl vakaip pakuppiṉaṅkaḷ. ivai A, B, AB, O eṉṉum iṉaṅkaḷākum. intap pakuppiṉaṅkaḷil, '0' iṉam tavira maṟṟa mūṉṟu iṉaṅkaḷiṉ uyiraṇukkaḷil nēriṇaiyāṉa kāppu mūlaṅkaḷaik (āṉṭijaṉ) koṇṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. '0' iṉattiṉ uyiraṇukkaḷil, 'A' kāppu mūlamō, 'B' kāppu mūlamō aṭaṅkiyirukkavillai. itaṉā lēyē, 'O' irattattai uṭaiyavarkaḷukkuc celuttalām. itaṉāl 'O' iṉam, potu iṉam eṉappaṭukiṟatu. oruvar enta iṉa irattattaik koṇṭirukkiṟārō anta iṉa irattam maṭṭumē avarukkuc celuttappaṭutal vēṇṭum.

blood-heat : kuruti veppaḷavu.

bloodless : kurutiyaṟṟa.

blood pressure : kuruti aḻuttam; iratta aḻuttam : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷiṉ cuvarkaḷil irattam uṇṭākkum aḻuttattiṉ aḷavu, potuvāka itu itayattil iruntu kuruti koṇṭu cellum nāḷaṅ kaḷākiya tamaṉikaḷil ēṟpaṭum aḻuttattaik kuṟikkiṟatu. kuruti aḻuttamāṉi eṉappaṭum karuviyaip payaṉpaṭutti, atiluḷḷa pātaraca aḷaviṉai milli mīṭṭaril kaṇakkiṭṭu iratta aḻuttam aḷaviṭap paṭukiṟatu. ovvoru itayat tuṭippiṉ pōtum tamaṉi iratta aḻuttam ēṟi iṟaṅkukiṟatu. itayattiliruntu tamaṉikaḷukku irattam pāyum aḷavaip poṟuttu itayac curukka aḻuttam mika uyarnta aḷavil irukkum. tamaṉi maṟṟum nuraiyīral tamaṉiyil taṭukkitaḻkaḷ (vālvu) muṭap paṭṭu, itayam taḷarcciyaṭaiyum pōtu, itayaccurukka aḻuttam mikak kuṟaivāka irukkum. inta mika uyarnta mikak kuṟainta aḻutta aḷavukaḷ pativu ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa (eṭuttukkāṭṭu : 120/70).

blood serum : kuruti niṇanīr(kuruti ūṉīr/kuruti vaṭinīr); kuruti ūṉīr; kuruti teḷinīr : kuruti uṟaiyumpōtu veḷippaṭum tiravam. itu, uṟaiyavaikkum poruḷ illāta uyiriyaṟ poruḷ (piḷāsmā) ākum.

blood transfusion : māṟṟuk kurutiyēttam : oruvar irattattai iṉṉoruvar iratta nāṭikku māṟṟutal.

blood urea : iratta mūttirai : irattattil purata vaḷarcitai māṟṟattiṉ kāraṇamāka iṟutiyāka uṇṭākum poruḷ (yūriyā). itaṉ aḷavu, iyalpāṉa varampukkuḷ māṟupaṭum. intap poruḷai mukkiyamāka veḷiyēṟṟukiṟa ciṟunīrakaṅkaḷ iyalpāka iyaṅkumpōtu, uṇaviluḷḷa puratattiṉ aḷaviṉāl itu pātikkappaṭuvatillai. ciṟunīrakaṅkaḷ nōyuṟumpōtu, iratta mūttiraiyiṉ aḷavu viraivāka atikamākiṟatu.

blue belly : nīla niṟavayiṟu : vayiṟṟiṉ uḷtōlil irattak kacivu ēṟpaṭumpoḻutu toppuḷaic cuṟṟiṉa vayiṟu nīla niṟattil kāṇappaṭum nilaimai.

body : uṭal.

body image : uṭal urukkāṭci; uṭalpimpam : oruvariṉ conta uṭal paṟṟi avaratu maṉatil tōṉṟum urukkāṭci. uṇavu uṇṇa viruppamillātapōtu, itu pōṉṟa maṉattiripukaḷ ēṟpaṭum.

body language : uṭal moḻi : oruvariṉ taṟpōtaiya uṭal nilaiyiṉaiyum, maṉa nilaiyiṉaiyum kuṟikkum, vāy moḻiyaṟṟa uṭaṟ kuṟiyīṭukaḷ. niṟkum tōraṇaikaḷ, muka pāvaṅkaḷ, iṭañcārnta nilai kaḷ, āṭaiyaṇikaḷ ākiyavai itil aṭaṅkum.

Boeck's disease : pōyak nōy : tacainār toṭarpāṉa oruvakai nōy.

Bohn's nodules : pōhṉ tiraḷai : piṟanta kuḻantaiyiṉ aṇṇattil uḷḷa nuṇṇiya veṇṇiṟa narampuk kaṇukkaḷ.

boil (syn furuncle) : koppuḷam : (kurutikkaṭṭi) : oru mayir mūṭṭup paiyaiccuṟṟi ēṟpaṭum kaṭumaiyāṉa vīkkam allatu kaṭṭi. itil potuvākac cīḻ kaṭṭum. araca piḷavai pōlaṉṟi, itil cīḻ vaṭivataṟku oru vāy irukkum.

bolus : kavaḷam : uṇavukkavaḷam viḻuṅkuvataṟku eḷitāka uḷḷa vakaiyil uruṇṭai vaṭivil tayārikkappaṭṭa oru maruntup poruḷ. uṭalil maruntāṉatu turitamākac ceyalpaṭuvataṟkāka, cirai nāḷam vaḻiyāka mika vēkamāka maruntaic celuttum muṟai.

Boividon : pōlviṭāṉ : miyāṉskiriṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

bonding : piṇaippu : oruvar maṟṟoruvaruṭaṉ koḷḷum uṇarvupūrvamāṉa piṇaippu. itu nīṇṭakāla uṇarcci mayamāṉa uṟavunilaikku iṉṟiyamaiyātatu. piṟanta kuḻantaikaḷ, tīvira maruttuvap pirivil kavaṉikkappaṭa vēṇṭiya pirivil kavaṉikkappaṭa vēṇṭiya cama yattil kuḻantaikkum peṟṟōrkaḷukkum, mukkiyamākat tāykkumiṭaiyē intappiṇaippu uyiriyal muṟaiyil iṉṟiyamaiyātatu. piṟanta kuḻantaikkum avaṟṟiṉ peṟṟōrukkum iṭaiyē aṉpu iṇaippai vaḷarppataṟkut taṉi muyaṟcikaḷ tēvai.

bone : elumpu : oruvakai iṇaipput ticu kālciyam kārpōṉēṭ,kālciyampāsḵpēṭa pōṉṟa uppupporuḷkaḷ itil paṭintu itaṉaik kaṭiṉamākki aṭarttiyākkukiṟatu. taṉittaṉi elumpukaḷ cērntu elumpukkūṭāka amaikiṉṟaṉa.

bone graft : elumpu oṭṭu maruttuvam : uṭampiṉ oru pakuti yiliruntu or elumputtuṇṭai eṭuttu iṉṉoru pakutiyil poruttutal allatu oruvariṭamiruntu iṉṉoruvarukku māṟṟip poruttutal. elumpuk kōḷāṟukaḷaic cīrpaṭuttuvataṟku allatu elumpu uruvākkat ticukkaḷai aḷippataṟku inta maruttuvam payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

bone marrow : elumpu maccai; elumpuc cōṟu; elumpu nāḷak kūḻ : elumpu uṭpuḻaiyiluḷḷa cōṟu pōṉṟa poruḷ. piṟakkumpōtu inta uṭpuḻaiyiṉuḷ, civappuc cōṟu pōl amainta, irattam niṟainti rukkum. piṉṉar, nīṇṭa elumpukaḷiṉuḷ koḻuppup poruḷ paṭintu civappuccōṟu, mañcaḷ elumpuccōṟāka māṟukiṟatu.

bone-marrous cancer (multiple myeloma) : elumpu maccaippuṟṟu : elumpuc cōṟu eṉappaṭum elumpu maccaiyil uḷḷa oru vakai iratta veḷḷai aṇukkaḷil paṭippaṭiyāka ēṟpaṭum puṟṟunōy. itil toṭakka nilaiyil, kāraṇamiṉṟi elumpu vali, aṭikkaṭit toṟṟu nōykaḷ, ciṟu nīrakam ceyaliḻattal pōṉṟa nōykkuṟikaḷ tōṉṟum. inta nōy potuvāka 40 vayatukku mēṟpaṭṭavarkaḷukku uṇṭākiṟatu. inta nōyaik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa orē vaḻi elumpu maccai māṟṟu aṟuvaic cikiccaiyēyākum. inta aṟuvaic cikiccaiyil, nōyuṟṟa maccai nīkkappaṭṭu, māṟṟāka ārōkkiyamāṉa elumpu maccai vaikkappaṭu kiṟatu.

bone-marrow transplant : elumpu maccai māṟṟu aṟuvai maruttuvam perumpālāṉa elumpukaḷiṉ maiyappakutiyil elumpuc cōṟu allatu elumpu maccai eṉṉum meṉmaiyāṉa ticu uḷḷaṉa. itutāṉ, uṭampi luḷḷa nōyait tīrppataṟkāṉa iratta veḷḷaṇukkaḷai uṟpatti ceytu, mutircciyaṭaiyac ceykiṟatu. elumpu maccaiyiṉ intac ceyalmuṟai cēta maṭaiyumpōtu nōyāḷi iṟantuviṭukiṟār. itait taṭuppataṟku māṟṟu aṟuvaic cikiccai mūlam nōyuṟṟa elumpu maccai uyiraṇukkaḷai akaṟṟiviṭṭu ataṟkup patilāka ārōkkiyamāṉa uyiraṇukkaḷai maccaiyil vaikkiṟārkaḷ. inta ārōkkiyamāṉa uyiraṇukkaḷai nōyāḷiyiṭamirunta eṭukkalām; illaiyeṉil inta uyiraṇukkaḷaip perumpālum mārpelumpiliruntu allatu iṭuppelumpu varai, mukaṭṭiliruntu eṭukkiṟārkaḷ. elumpil pala tuḷaikaḷiṭṭu ūcikaḷ mūlam maccai eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. itu nōyāḷikku narampu vaḻiyākac celuttappaṭukiṟatu. nōyai etirkkum uyiraṇuk kaṟṟaikaḷiṉ muṉṉōṭikaḷāṉa naṭuttaṇṭu uyiraṇukkaḷaiyum nōyuṟṟa uyiraṇukkaḷukkup patilāka vaikkalām. naṭuttaṇṭu uyir aṇukkaḷai, elumpu maccai irattam, toppuḷkoṭi irattam allatu karuppaic cicuviṉ nuraiyīraliliruntu eṭukkalām.

bonesetter : elumpu poruttunar.

bony : elumpu cārnta.

bony landmark : elumpu aṭaiyāḷam : uṭal uṟuppukaḷiṉ iruppiṭaṅkaḷai aṭaiyāḷam kāṇa utavum elumpup perukkam.

Boop : pūp : pirāṅkiyōlaiṭṭis āpliṭoraṉs ārkaṉaiciṅ nimōṉiyā eṉṉum nōyiṉ āṅkilac coṟṟoṭariṉ mutal eḻuttuc cērkkai. mūccunuṇ kuḻāy ﻿kaḷ aḻaṟciyuṟṟu muṟṟilumāka aḻintu pōvatāl ēṟpaṭukiṉṟa nuraiyīral aḻaṟci nōyaik kuṟippatu.

booster : ceyalūkki; ūkkuvippu ūci : oruvarukku ēṟkaṉavē tarappaṭṭa taṭuppu ūciyiṉ ceyalai ūkkuvippataṟkākap pōṭappaṭum maṟṟoru taṭuppūci. (e-ṭu) kuḻantaikaḷukku 1 1/2, 2 1/2, 3 1/2 mātaṅkaḷil muttaṭuppūci pōṭappaṭum. itaṉ ūkkuvippu ūcikaḷ muṟaiyē oṉṟarai, nāṉkarai vayatukaḷil pōṭappaṭum.

broach : paṟkūḻ nīkkik karuvi : paṟcitaivu nōyiṉpōtu paṟkūḻaiyum ataic cārnta citaivut ticukkaḷaiyum akaṟṟa utavum ūcimuṉaik karuvi. broad bandage : akalakkaṭṭu.

Broca index : pirākkā kuṟiyīṭu; pirākkā cuṭṭu eṇ : oru varuṭaiya vayatiṟkum uyarattiṟkumēṟpa irukka vēṇṭiya iyalpāṉa uṭal eṭaiyaiviṭa 20 catavikitam atikamiruttal.

Brock's syndrome : puruk nōyiyam : iṅkilāntu aṟuvaic cikiccai vallunar rucel purūk iṉamkaṇṭu aṟinta nōyiyam. itu oruvakai nuraiyīral aḻaṟci aṭaippu nōy. kācanōy niṇanīrk kaṭṭikaḷāl nuraiyīraliṉ mattiya maṭal aṭaittuk koḷḷal.

broiling : aṉal vāṭṭal.

bromhexine : purōmhekciṉ : caḷiyai iḷakkum maruntu. itu vāyvaḻi uṭkoḷḷappaṭukiṟatu. itu irumalukku muṉpu caḷiyai iḷakkukiṟatu. īḷai nōy (āstumā) uṭaiyavarkaḷukku narampu vaḻiyākac celuttum maruntākavum kiṭaikkiṟatu.

bromosulphthalein test : purōmōcalḵptālaiṉ cōtaṉai : nuraiyīral ceyaṟpaṭuvataik kaṇittaṟivataṟkākap payaṉpaṭum cōtaṉai. uṭal eṭaiyiṉ oru kilō kirāmukku 5 milli kirām eṉṟa vītattil nīlac cāyam ūci mūlam narampu vaḻiyākac celuttappaṭukiṟatu. avvāṟu celuttappaṭṭa 45 nimiṭattiṟkup piṉṉarum irattattil 5%-kku mēl cāyam cuṟṟōṭṭattil irukkumāṉāl appōtu kallīraliṉ ceyaṟpāṭu paḻutupaṭṭirukkiṟatu eṉṟu aṟiyappaṭukiṟatu.

Brompton mixture : purōmpṭaṉ kalavai : ālkahāl, apiṉi (mārḵpiṉ), kōkkaiṉ aṭaṅkiya oru maruntuk kalavai. kaṭaikkaṇu mūṭṭu valivaik kuṟaikka itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. brom-valetone : purōmvāleṭṭōṉ : oru meṉmaiyāṉa mayakka maruntu. kārpurōmāl maruntiṉaip pōṉṟatu.

bronchiectasis : mūccukkuḻāy taḷarvu; cuvācak kuḻal virivu : nuraiyīralil mūccukkuḻalkaḷ iyalpukku mīṟi virintiruttal. inta virivunilai eppōtum nilaipeṟṟatāka irukkum. mūccukkuḻal cuvarkaḷil aṇukkaḷ citaivuṟṟirukkum. itu mella mella vaḷarcci peṟum. mūccuk kuḻal virivaṭaintuḷḷa aḷavu atil ēṟpaṭum nōyttoṟṟu aḷavu maṟṟum aṅku uṇṭākum curappu nīr aḷavu ivaṟṟaip poṟuttu nōyiṉ aṟikuṟikaḷ veḷippaṭum. itaṉāl pātikkappaṭum naparukkut toṭarcciyāka caḷiyum irumalum vantu koṇṭirukkum. paṭukkum pōtu irumal atikarikkum.

mūccukkuḻāy taḷarvu ularnta nilai : inta nilaimaiyiṉ pōtu mūccuk kuḻalkaḷil nōyttoṟṟu iruppatillai. āṉāl, vaṟaṭṭu irumal tollai tarum camayaṅkaḷil irumalōṭu caḷiyil irattamum veḷiyēṟum.

bronchiole : mūccu nuṇkuḻāy; mūccuk kuḻāy nuṇpirivu; cuvāca nuṇkuḻal; mūccu nuṇkuḻāy : mūccuk kiḷaik kuḻal pala muṟai piḷantu, mūccuc ciṟu kuḻalkaḷākac ciṟuttu, mīṇṭum palamuṟai pirintu ciṟuttu, iṟutiyil mūccu nuṇkuḻāykaḷāka uruppeṟukiṉṟaṉa. ivai cavvup paṭalamākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivai meṉ tacaikaḷāl āṉavai. ivai mēlum pirintu pirāṇa vāyuvaip pakirum mūccu nuṇmak kuḻalkaḷāka amai kiṉṟaṉa. vēṟṟaic cuṟṟi nuraiyīral kaṭṭamaippiṉ kaṭaittaḷamāṉa mūccu nuṇṇaṟaikaḷ amaintu uḷḷaṉa.

bronchiolectasis : mūccu nuṇ kuḻāy taḷarvu; cuvāca nuṇ kuḻāy virivu : mūccu nuṇ kuḻalkaḷ virinta nilaiyil iruttal.

bronchiolitis : mūccu kuḻāy nuṇpirivu vīkkam; mūccu nuṇ kuḻāy aḻaṟci : mūccukkuḻāy nuṇ pirivukaḷ vīkkamaṭaital. potuvāka, kuḻantaikaḷukku oru vayatukkuḷ ēṟpaṭum.

bronchodilatation : cuvācak kuḻal taḷarcci; mūccukkuḻāy taḷarcci : cuvācak kuḻalkaḷiṉ uḷviṭṭam atikarittal. ﻿bronchogenic : mūccukkuḻāy cārnta; mūccukkuḻal toṭarpu uḷḷa; mūccukkuḻal nuraiyīral puṟṟunōy : mūccuk kuḻaliliruntu tuvaṅkum puṟṟunōy. itu ciṟṟaṇuvakaip puṟṟu nōy, ciṟṟaṇu illāta vakaip puṟṟunōy, skuvāmas aṇuvakaip puṟṟunōy, aṭiṉō aṇuvakaip puṟṟu nōy, citainta vakaip puṟṟu nōy eṉa vakaippaṭuttappaṭṭu uḷḷatu. nuraiyīral puṟṟu nōyk kaḻalaikaḷ mūccuk kuḻalkaṇuk kuḻiyai oṭṭiyō, nuraiyīral uṟaikku arukilō allatu mēṟkūṟiya iraṇṭiṟkum mattiyilō amaiyalām.

bronchomycosis : nuraiyīral nōy : mūccuk kuḻāykaḷaiyum, nuraiyīralkaḷaiyum pātikkum palavakaik kāḷāṉ cārnta nōykaḷ.

darwinian theory : ṭārviṉiyak kōṭpāṭu : "aṉaittup pirāṇi kaḷiṉ vaḻittōṉṟalkaḷum taṅkaḷ peṟṟōrkaḷiliruntu caṟṟē vēṟupaṭṭirukkum" eṉṟu cārlas ṭārviṉ (1809-1882) vakutta uyir malarccik kōṭpāṭu eṉum paṭi malarccik koḷkai avvāṟu māṟupaṭṭa vaḻit tōṉṟalkaḷil taṅkaḷ cūḻalkaḷukkēṟpat taṅkaḷait takavamaittuk koḷḷum tiṟaṉ uṭaiyavai uyir vaḷarkiṉṟaṉa; maṟṟavai iṟantu viṭukiṉṟaṉa.

eosiophil : civappūtāc cāya uyiraṇu : civappūtāc cāyam ēṟkum uyiraṇukkaḷ.

eosinophilia : civappūtāc cāya uyiraṇu mikuti; kurutic cevvaṇu nalivu : irattattil civap pūtāc cāyapporuḷ uyir aṇukkaḷ atikamāka iruttal.

Epanutin : ippāṉuṭṭiṉ : ḵpeṉiṭṭāyaṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

epicanthus : kaṭaikkaṇ maṟaippu; kaṇmūlai maṭippu : kaṭaik kaṇṇiṉ uṭpuṟattai maṟaikkum tōl vaḷarcci. itu piṟaviyilēyē uṇṭākiṟatu.

epigenetic : uyiriyakka māṟutal : uyirikaḷiṉ celvākkiṉāl uṇṭākum māṟutalkaḷ. āṉāl itu marapaṇuk kaṭṭamaippil ēṟpaṭum māṟutalkaḷiṭaiyil uṇṭāvatillai.

epilepsy : kākkāy valippu; valippu nōy; icivu nōy : mūḷai oru kaṇippoṟi pōṉṟatu. kaṇippoṟi pōlavē, mūḷai aṇukkaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu iṇaikkappaṭṭaḷḷaṉa. miṉṉaṇu vēkattil uṭaliṉ ellāp pakutikaḷukkum toṭarpu koḷkiṉṟaṉa. cila vēḷaikaḷil mūḷaiyil vaḻakkattiṟku māṟāka atircci ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉai 'valippu' eṉkiṟōm, mūḷaiyiliruntu kaṭṭukkaṭaṅkāmal miṉkānta āṟṟal veḷippaṭum pōtu inta valippu uṇṭākiṟatu. mūḷai viraivilēyē iyalpunilaikku vantuviṭuvatāl valippu nōyāḷikaḷ iyalpāka enta nōyk kuṟikaḷum teṉpaṭuvatillai. valippu nōyil palavakaikaḷ uṇṭu cāppiṭumpōtu valippu vantāl atu 'cāppāṭṭu valippu (Eating epilepsy) eṉappaṭum; cirikkumpōtu ēṟpaṭum valippu (Laughing epilepsy) ākum; cilar vennīrait toṭṭāl valippu varum atu "vennīr valippu".

innōyāḷikaḷ ūrtikaḷ oṭṭuvataiyum, āṟu, kuḷaṅkaḷil kuḷippataiyum, vaṉmuṟaik kāṭcikaḷ niṟainta tiraippaṭaṅkaḷaiyum, tolaik kāṭci nikaḻccikaḷaiyum pārppataiyum, kūriyamuṉaikaḷai uṭaiya poruḷkaḷaik kaiyāḷvatait tavirppatu nallatu. naṉku uṟaṅkutal, camaccīruṇavu uṇṇutal, kuṟippiṭṭa maruttuvak kavaṉippu, ciṟanta poḻutu pōkku ākiyavai mikunta nalaṉ payakkum.

epileptic : kākkāy valippu nōyāḷi; valippu nōyāḷi : kākkāy valippu nōyuṭaiyavar. epileptiform : pōli kākkāy valippu : kākkāy valippu allatu ataṉ aṟikuṟikaḷai ottirukkiṟatu.

epithelialization : tōliḻaimap paṭalamātal; puṟattōliya mūṭṭam: kāyampaṭṭa pakutiyil mēl tōliḻaimap paṭalam paṭarutal. itu kāyam kuṇamaṭaivataṉ iṟutik kaṭṭam.

Erb's area : erp maṇṭalam : mārpelumpup pakkak kiḷaiyākavuḷḷa mūṉṟāvatu iṭatu iṭaiveḷi potuvāka iraṇṭāvatu peruntamaṉi maṇṭalam eṉa aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu. jermaṉ maruttuva aṟiñar vilhelm erp peyarāl aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu. inta iṭattil peruntamaṉiyiṉ virikuruti aḻutta muṇu muṇuppu naṉku kēṭkiṟatu. Erb's palsy : erp muṭakkuvātam : tōḷ, puyam ākiyavaṟṟiṉ tacaikaḷil ēṟpaṭum pakka vātam. aintāvatu āṟāvatu kaḻuttu narampu vērkaḷil uṇṭākum puṇ kāraṇamāka itu ēṟpaṭukiṟatu. itaṉāl puyam ceyaliḻantu toṅkum. perumpālum piṟaviyilēyē ēṟpaṭum kāyattiṉāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu.

Erb's paralysis : erp muṭakku vātam : tōḷ, kaittacaik kuḻumattil ēṟpaṭum muṭakku vātam. aintāvatu, āṟāvatu mutukuttaṇṭu narampukaḷiṉ kaḻuttu vērppakutikaḷil itu uṇṭākiṟatu. jermaṉ narampi yalaṟiñar vilhelm erp peyarāl aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu.

erectile : nimirttakkūṭiya; viraikkakkūṭiya; viraikkum : viṟaip pākki eḻuppak kūṭiya tika.

ergotism : roṭṭi nōy : ūcip pōṉa tāṉiya māviṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa roṭṭiyiṉāl uṇṭākum nōy. ergotrate : erkōṭrēṭ : erkōmeṭraiṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

eruption : pokkuḷam; tōl koppuḷam : tiṭīr veṭippu, paru. pal vakaiyil īṟṟiṉai ūṭuruvi ēṟpaṭum veṭippu.

Erysichthon syndrome : ericiktōṉ nōy; kuṇṭōtarap paci : aḷavukkumīṟiya itayattuṭippu, aṭaṅkāta paci, kaṇṭa uṇavukaḷai uṇṇum vēṭkai ākiyavai uṇṭākum oru nilaimai. kirēkkap purāṇattil varum kuṇṭōtaraṉ tīrāp paciyuṭaiya oru katāppāttirat tiṉ peyarāl inta nōy aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu.

erysipelas : akki; ceñcarumam : uṭal mītu tiṇcivappu niṟam paṭarum nōy vakai. itaṉāl kāyccalum, cerimāṉak kōḷāṟukaḷum uṇṭākum.

erythema : tōltaṭippu nōy; centaṭippu : tōl mītu civappu niṟattil paṭṭai paṭṭaiyākat taṭippu viḻumnōy.

erythralgia : tōl civappunōy : tōlil valiyum, civappu niṟamum ēṟpaṭum oru nilai.

erythroblast : elumpu maccaic civappaṇu; kuruttuc civappaṇu : civappu elumpu maccaiyil (elumpuc cōṟu) kāṇappaṭum karumaiya irattac civappaṇu. itiliruntu civappu aṇukkaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa.

Erythrocin : eritrōciṉ : eritrōmaiciṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

erythroblast: mutirācivappaṇu : mutirānilaiyiluḷḷa irattac civappaṇu. karumaiyamuṭaiya civappaṇu.

human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) : maṉita nōyt taṭaikkāppuk kuṟaipāṭṭu nōyk kirumi (HIV) : RNA eṉṟa marapaṇu uyirmam koṇṭuḷḷanalivuṟuttum nōykirumiyiṉ metuvākac ceyaṟpaṭum oru uṭkuṭumpam. inta nōyk kirumic cerimāṉap poruḷ, maṟutalai paṭiyeṭuppiṉaic ceykiṟatu. itu tāy uyiraṇuvil nōyk kirumi ūṭuruvatait toṭarntu, RNA marapaṇu uyirmattiṉ DNA paṭiyeṭukkum kuṇamuṭaiyatu inta DNA paṭiyāṉatu aṅkoṉṟum iṅkoṉṟumāka ūṭuruvic ceṉṟu tāy uyiraṇuvuṭaṉ oruṅkiṇaikiṟatu. itu putiya RNA paṭikaḷai eṭuppataṟku oru meṉtakaṭākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. inta HIV nōyk kirumikaḷ, HIV-1, HIV-2 eṉṟu iruvakaiyāka uḷḷaṉa. HIV nōyk kirumi CD4+ helppar T eṉṟa ciṟiya kuruti veḷḷaṇukkaḷait tākki, CD4+ uyiraṇukkaḷuṭaṉ urāyntu, nōyt taṭaikkāppuc ceyaṟ pāṭṭiṉaip paṭippaṭiyākak kuṟaikkiṟatu.

hyperkinesis : mikai iyakkam; aticalaṉam.

hyperkinetic syndrome : mikai iyakka nōy : perumpālum 2-4 vayatuk kuḻantaikaḷukku ēṟpaṭum nōy. innōy kaṇṭa kuḻantaikaḷukku maṉa vaḷarcci metuvāka naṭaipeṟum. aḷavukku mīṟiya muraṭṭuttaṉam ēṟpaṭum. accamiṉmaiyum, entat taṇṭaṉaiyum añcāta pōkkum kāṇappaṭum.

hyperlipidaemia : uṭal ticukkoḻuppu mikaippu : cuṟṟōṭṭamākac cellum koḻuppu amilaṅkaḷ, ṭiraikiḷicaraiṭikaḷ, kolasṭirāl ākiyavaṟṟiṉ aḷavu atikamāka iruttal. itu marapaṇu nōy, cīraṇanōy pōṉṟa cikkalāṉa etiretir viḷaivukaḷai uṇṭākkukiṟatu.

hyperlipaemia : mikaikkoḻuppu : irattattil aḷavukku atikamākak koḻuppu iruttal.

hyperlithuria : mikaiyūrik amilac curappu : ciṟunīril yūrik amilattiṉ aḷavu atikamākac karattal.

hyperlysinaemia : taṉ iṉakkīṟṟuk kuṟaivu nōy : kuḻantaip paruvattil ēṟpaṭum taṉ iṉak kīṟṟuk kuṟaivunilai. itil laiciṉ allatu ataṉ vaḷarcitai viṉaimāṟṟap poruḷkaḷ atikamāka irukkum.

hypermagnesoemia : mikai makṉīciyam : kurutiyil aḷavukku mīṟi makṉīciyam iruttal. itaṉāl ciṟunīrakacceyaliḻappu uṇṭākum. atika aḷavu makṉīciyam aṭaṅkiya vayiṟṟup puḷippakaṟṟum maruntiṉai uṭ koḷvatālum itu uṇṭākum.

hypermetabolism : mikai vaḷar citaimāṟṟam : uṭalil aḷavukku atikamāka veppam uṇṭātal.

hypermetropia : tolaip pārvaik kēḷāṟu; tūrappārvai : kaṇtavaṟāṉa iṭattil amain tiruppatāl ēṟpaṭum kōḷāṟu. itaṉāl, oḷikkatirkaḷ, viḻit ﻿tiraiyiṉ mēl viḻuvataṟkup patilāka, ataṟku appāl viḻukiṉṟaṉa.

hypermobility : mikai acaivu; atiyacaivu : aḷavukku mīṟi iyakkat taṉmaiyuṭaṉiruttal.

hypermorph : mikai uṟuppu nīṭci : nīṇṭa kaikālkaḷ uṭaiya or āḷ. itaṉāl, ivaruṭaiya niṟkum uyaram, uṭkārntirukkum uyarattai viṭa atikamāka irukkum.

hypernatraemia : mikai cōṭiyam; kuruti uppu mikaippu : aḷavukku mīṟi nīrveḷiyēṟuvatāl irattattil aḷavukku atikamāka cōṭiyam iruttal.

hypernephroma : ciṟunīrakac curappippuṟṟu : ciṟunīrakac curappip puṟṟunōy. valiyillāmal, iṭaiviṭṭu ciṟunīrkkuruti ērāḷamākap pōkum.

hyperonychia : mikai nakam;ati nakam : nakaṅkaḷ aḷavukku atikamāka vaḷartal.

hyperorthocytosis : mikaiveḷḷaṇu : palvēṟu vakai uyir aṇukkaḷ iyalpāṉa vītattil irukkumpōtu, kuruti veḷḷaṇukkaḷ mika atikamāka iruttal.

hyperosmolar diabetic coma : mikai nīriḻivu mayakkam : kurutiyil mika uyarnta aḷavukku carkkarai atikarippatāl uṇṭākum iyalpu kaṭanta, ellā uṇarccikaḷum iḻanta muḻu mayakkanilai.

hyperoxaluria : mikai kālciyam ākcālūriyā : ciṟunīril aḷavukku mikutiyākak kālciyam ākcālēṭ iruttal.

hyperperistalsis : mikait tacaic curukkam; atiyaḷavu : uṇavu cāram eḷitil celvataṟku icaivāṉa tāṉiyaṅkik kuṭal tacaikaḷiṉ curukku alaikaḷ mikutiyāka iruttal.

hyperphagia : peruntīṉi atiyuṇavu : aḷavukku atikamāka uṇṇutal.

hyperphosphataemia : mikai ḵpāsḵpēṭ kuruti : irattattil ḵpāsḵpēṭṭukaḷ mikutiyāka iruttal.

hyperpigmentation : mikai niṟamiyākkam; ati niṟamēṟṟam : niṟamiyākkam aḷavukku atikamāka naṭaipeṟutal.

hyperpituitarism : arakka vaḷarcci : uṭal vaḷarccikku mukkiyamāka utavuvatākak karutappaṭum mūḷaiyaṭic curappiyil aḷavukku atikamāka iyakku nīr curantu arakka uruvam uṇṭātal.

hyperplasia : mikaiyaṇuvaḷarcci; ati perukkam :uyir ticuvaṇukkaḷ aḷavukku atikamāka uruvātal.

hyperplasmia : mikai uyiraṇup perukkam : uyiraṇukkaḷiṉ eṇṇikkai maṭṭumīṟiya eṇṇikkaiyil iruttal. itaṉāl or uṟuppiṉ vaṭivaḷavu atikarittuviṭum.

hyperploidy : mikai iṉakkīṟṟu : iṉakkīṟṟukaḷ iyalpāṉa eṇṇikkaiyai viṭa oṉṟu allatu iraṇṭu atikamāka irukkum nilai.

hypernoea : mūccut tiṇaṟal : viraivāṉa āḻnta cuvācam; mūccut tiṇaṟal.

hyperproteosis : mikaip puratam : cīruṇavil puratattiṉ aḷavu aḷavukku atikamāvatāl ēṟpaṭum nilai.

hyperpyrexia : mikaik kāyccal; kaṭuṅkāyccal; kaṭuñcuram : uṭal veppanilai 40-41°C-kku atikamāka iruttal.

hypesecretion : mikaic curappu : uṭalil curappunīr aḷavukku atikamākac curattal.

hypersensitivity : ovvāmai; mikaiuṇarvu kūṟuṇarvu : oru tuṇṭutal allatu ūṟu poruḷ kāraṇamāka aḷavukku atikamāka uṇarccivayap paṭutal.

hypersplenism : mikai maṇṇīral curappu : maṇṇīralil aḷavukku atimākac curappu ēṟpaṭutal. itu maṇṇīral vīkkam kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭukiṟatu.

hypertalorism : mikai maṇṭait tiripu; ati vilaku puruvam : maṉa vaḷarccik kuṟaipāṭu kāraṇamāka uṇṭākum maṇṭaiyōṭu cārnta tiripukkōḷāṟu (tāḻnta neṟṟi, kūriya uccit talai).

hypertension : mikaik kuruti aḻuttam; pēraḻuttam; kuruti uyar aḻuttam; mikai iratta aḻuttam : mika maṭṭumīṟi uyarnta iratta aḻuttam. itu mūḷai iyakkam maṟṟum pala curappu cārnta kāraṇaṅkaḷāl uṇṭākiṟatu.

hyperthermia : mikai veppanilai; ativeppanilai : oru puṟṟukkaṭṭiyai veppattiṉ mūlam karaippataṟku uṭalil uṇṭākkappaṭum mika atika aḷavu veppanilai.

hyperthyroidism : mikaik kēṭayac curappi nōy; kēṭayamikai : kēṭayac curappiyil (tairāyṭu) curappunīr mika atikamāka curappatāl uṇṭākum nōy.

hypertonia : mikait tacaittiṇmai; ati viṟaippu : tacaik ﻿kaṭṭamaippil tiṇmai aḷavukku atikamāka iruttal.

hypertonic : mikaittacai viṟaippu : 1. tacaiyiṟukkam, viṟaippu atikamātal, 2. oppīṭṭuk karaicalai viṭa ūṭukacivu aḻuttam atikamāka iruttal.

hypertonicity : mikaittacai tiṇmai : 1. uṭal nīrmaṅkaḷiṉ ūṭukacivu aḻuttam atikamāka iruttal.

hypertrichosis : mikaimayir aṭartti : potuvāka mayir atikamillāta iṭaṅkaḷil mayir aḷavukku atikamāka aṭarntiruttal (e.ṭu) neṟṟi.

hypertrophy : uṟuppup porumal; mikai vaḷarcci; perukkam; ativaḷappam; vaḷarvu mikai : mikai ūṭṭattāl ēṟpaṭum uṟuppup porumal.

hyperviscosity : kuruti nīrmikaik kuḻaimam : kuruti nīrk kuḻaimanilai kaṇicamāka atikarittiruttal. itu potuvāka vālṭaṉsṭirām vēril kāṇappaṭum. itil cuṟṟōṭṭamākac cellum IgM kuruti nīr uyiraṇu aparimitamāka atikarikkum. IgG, IgA kurutinīr uyiraṇukkaḷ caṟṟu kuṟaivāka irukkum.

hiperuricaemia : mikai ciṟunīr amilam : irattattil ciṟunīr amilam aḷavukku atikamāka iruttal. itu kīlvātattiṉ aṟikuṟi.

hyperventilation : mikai mūccu : cālicailēṭ naccu, talaik kāyam pōṉṟa nēraṅkaḷil mikutiyāka mūccuviṭutal.

hypervitaminosis : uyirccattu mikaippu; mikai vaiṭṭamiṉ : vaiṭṭamiṉkaḷai, mukkiyamāka vaiṭṭamiṉ D-ai atikaaḷavu uṭkoḷvatāl uṇṭākum nilaimai.

hyper volaemia : mikaik kurutiyōṭṭam : cuṟṟōṭṭamākac cellum kurutiyiṉ aḷavu atikamāka iruttal.

hypeaema : kaṇ aṟaik kuruti; kuruti muṉṉaṟai : kaṇ muṉpuṟa aṟaiyil kuruti iruttal.

hyphema : viḻittiraippaṭalak kāyam : viḻittiraippaṭattil ēṟpaṭum kāyam. itaṉāl muṉpuṟa aṟaikkuḷ irattam oḻukum.

hypnogenesis : tuñcunilai; tūṇṭiviṭal.

hypnology : arituyilil : maṉa āṟṟal koṇṭu tūṇṭappaṭum arituyil paṟṟiya āyviyal.

hypnosis : arituyil nilai : maṉa āṟṟal koṇṭu tūṇṭap ﻿paṭum arituyil, valiyaṟṟa makappēṟu, palpiṭuṅkutal, aritāka ciṟiya aṟuvaic cikiccai ākiyavaṟṟukku itu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

hypnotherapy : arituyal maruttuva muṟai : maṉa āṟṟal mūlam nīṇṭa uṟakkattai allatu arituyilait tūṇṭic cikiccaiyaḷittal.

hypnotic : 1, arituyil maruntu; uṟakka ūkkayim; uṟakka mūṭṭi; vaciyam : arituyilait tūṇṭukiṟa maruntu, 2. arituyilāḷar : maṉa āṟṟalāl tūṇṭappaṭum arituyil nilaikku āṭpaṭṭavar.

hypnotism : uṟakka mamuṭukkam; aṟituyiluttuvam : puṟattūṇṭu taliṉ mītu maṭṭumē ceyalāṟṟum iyalpuṭaiya ceyaṟkaiyāṉa arituyil nilai.

Hypnovel : hipṉōval : meṭā cōlam eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

hypoactivity : ceyalnalivu : ceyalmuṟai kuṟaintiruttal allatu piṉṉaṭaintiruttal.

hypoadrenocorticism : aṇṇīrakak kuṇṭikkāy iyakkunīr curappuk kuṟaivu : aṇṇīrakak kuṇṭikkāy iyakkunīr curattal kuṟaital. allatu ataṉ viḷaivu.

hypoaesthesia : kuṉṟuṇaicci; tāḻuṇairvu : uṭaliṉ ōr uṟuppil uṇarcci kuṉṟiyiruttal.

hypoalbuminosis : karuppurata kuṟaipāṭu : karuppuratam aḷavukku mīṟikkuṟaivāka iruttal.

hypobaric : cuṟṟōṭṭa vāyu aḻuttak kuṟaivu : vāyu maṇṭala aḻuttattaiviṭa 1 kuṟaivāka irukkum cuṟṟōṭṭa vāyukkaḷiṉ aḻuttam toṭarpuṭaiya.

hypobarism : uṭal aḻuttak kuṟaipāṭu : ticu ākcijaṉ illāmal uṭampil pāramāṉi aḻuttam kuṟaivatāl uṇṭākum nilai.

hypobaropathy : pāramāṉa aḻuttak kuṟaivu nōy : pāramāṉi aḻuttam kuṟaivatāl uṇṭākum nōy.

hypocalcaemia : kālciyam kuṟaipāṭu : irattattil kālciyam kuṟaivāka iruttal.

hypocapnia : kariyamila vāyuk kuṟaivu : tamaṉi irattattil kārpaṉṭaiyākcaiṭu (kariya mila CO,vāyu) kuṟaivāka iruttal.

hypochloraemia : kuḷōraiṭuk kuṟaipāṭu : cuṟṟōṭṭa irattattil kuḷōraiṭukaḷ kuṟaivāka iruttal. ﻿hypochlorhydria : haiṭrō kuḷōrik amilak kuṟaipāṭu : amilakkuṟai iraippai nīril haiṭrō kuḷōrik amilam kuṟaivāka iruttal.

hypochlorite : haippōkuḷōraiṭ : haippōkuḷōras amilattiṉ vaṇikap peyar. kāyaṅkaḷaik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

hypochondria : maṉavāṭṭa nōy; nōymaik kalakkam; nōyeṇṇam : cūmpaṭaivuk kōḷāṟu, kaṟpaṉaip piṇi, meḷaṭṭīka nōy.

hypochondriac : maṉavāṭṭa nōyāḷi : meḷaṭṭīka nōyāḷi.

hypochondriasis : pīti nōy; maṉappāṭu; nōyeṇṇam : nōy kuṇamaṭaintuviṭum eṉṟu maruttuva muṟaiyil uṟuti kūṟiyapiṟakum oruvariṭam iṭaiviṭāmal ericcalūṭṭum pīti kuṭikoṇṭiruttal.

hypochondrium : kīḻvilā elumpup pakuti; vilāvaṭi : kīḻ vilā elumpukaḷukkuk kīḻē uḷḷa aṭivayiṟṟiṉ mēl kiṭaimaṭṭap pakuti (iṭam, valam).

hypocholesteraemia : kurutik koḻuppuk kuṟaipāṭu : cuṟṟōṭ ṭamākac cellum kurutiyil koḻuppuc cattu (Cholesterol) kaṇicamākak kuṟaintiruttal.

hypochondroplasia : mikai āṭṭōcōmāl : āṭṭōcōmāl ātikkam peṟṟirukkum nilai. itaṉāl, kuḷḷa uruvam, kuṭṭai uṟuppukaḷ, vālvaḻi uṭkuḻal ākiyavai uṇṭākum.

hypochromasia : kurutic civappaṇuk kuṟaipāṭu : kurutic civap paṇukkaḷil kurutic civappaṇukkaḷ kuṟaivāka irukkum nilai.

hypochromia : civappaṇuk kuṟaivu nōy : 1. civappaṇuk kuṟaipāṭu, 2. kurutic cōkaiyiṉ oru nilai. itil kurutic civappaṇukkaḷ iyalpāṉa aḷavai viṭak kuṟainta vītattil irukkum.

hypochromic : niṟamikkuṟaipāṭu : irattac civappaṇukkaḷil cenniṟak kurutiyaṇukkaḷ kuṟaivāka iruppataṉ kāraṇamāka vaṇṇap poruḷ allatu niṟami kuṟaivāka iruttal.

hypocythaemia : kuruti aṇukkaḷ kuṟaipāṭu : cuṟṟōṭṭamākac cellum kurutiyil civappu, veḷḷaṇukkaḷum, takaṭṭaṇukkaḷum, kaṇicamāṉa aḷavuk kuṟaintiruttal. itu putut tacai vaḷarcciyaṭaiyāta cōṉaka nōy pōṉṟa nilai. ﻿hypoderma : tōl kūṭṭuppuḻu: tōl cārnta puḻup paruvattiluḷḷa oṟṟait talaivali uṇṭākum kutirai ī vakaiyaic cērnta kūṭṭup puḻu.

hypogastrium : aṭiyakaṭṭup pakuti; untik kīḻppakuti : aṭi vayiṟṟiṉ aṭiyakaṭṭup pakuti.

hypogenesis : uṟuppuk kuṟai vaḷarcci : uṭampiṉ pakutikaḷ allatu uṟuppukaḷ kuṟai vaḷarcciyuṭaṉiruttal.

hypogenitalism : pāluṟuppu vaḷarccik kuṟaipāṭu : puṟappiṟap puṟuppukaḷ pakuti allatu pakuti mutirā nilaiyil iruttal. itu potuvāka, pālaṇu uyiraṇukkaḷai uṟpatti ceyyum uṟuppu pōtiya aḷavu vaḷarcci peṟātatāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu.

hypoglycaemia : kurutik kuḷukkōs kuṟaipāṭu; kurutic cārk karaik kuṟai : kurutiyil kuḷukkōs kuṟaivāka iruttal. itaṉāl, kavalai, maṉakkiḷarcci, āḻnta uṟakka nilai, caṉṉi ākiyavai uṇṭākum. nīriḻivu nōyāḷikaḷukku iṉculiṉ atikamākak koṭuttu viṭṭāl innilai ēṟpaṭalām. ﻿hypokalaemia : poṭṭāciyam kuṟaipāṭu : kurutiyil poṭṭāciyam aḷavu mikamikak kuṟaintu viṭutal.

insulin preparations : iṉculiṉ tayārippukaḷ : viraivākac ceyaṟ paṭum naṭuttaramākac ceyaṟpaṭum eṉpiec aicōḵpēṉ, nīṇṭa kālam ceyaṟpaṭak kūṭiya (purōṭṭō miṉ tuttanāka iṉculiṉ-PZI) pōṉṟa iṉculiṉ tayārippukaḷ. tūymaiyākkiya pōrciṉ, ākṭirāppiṭ, iṉcalāṭṭārṭ, miksṭārṭ ākiyavai maṉita iṉculiṉ.

insulin tolerance test : iṉculiṉ tāṅkutiṟaṉ cōtaṉai : iṉcu liṉaip payaṉpaṭuttik koḷvataṟkāṉa uṭaliṉ tiṟaṉai aṟivataṟkāṉa cōtaṉai, kurutiyiluḷḷa kuḷukkōs aḷavu iṉculiṉ celutti avvappōtu aḷaviṭappaṭukiṟatu. kuruti kuḷukkōs aḷavu 30 nimiṭattil kuṟaintu, 90 nimiṭattukkup piṟaku mīṇṭum iyalpu nilaikkut tirumpu kiṟatu. kālciyam kuṟaipāṭuḷḷa nōyāḷikaḷiṭam kaḷukkōs kuṟaiyum aḷavu kuṟaivākavum iyalpu nilaikkut tirumpum nēram kuṟaivākavum irukkum.

jēkcaṉ peyarāl aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu. iru tarappāṉatacait tuṭippu acaivukaḷ ēṟpaṭum. inta acaivukaḷ oru tacaik kuḻumattil toṭaṅki paṭippaṭiyāka aṭuttuḷḷa kuḻumattukkup paravukiṟatu. itu kākkāy valippu naṭavaṭikkai, kaṭṭaḷai mūḷai mēluṟai mūlamāka vāy, kaṭṭai viral, pātam ākiyavaṟṟukku nakarvataik kuṟikkiṟatu. intap pātippu, cila viṉāṭikaḷ mutal pala maṇinēram varai māṟupaṭṭa kālattukku nīṭikkalām.

Kupffer's cells : kupḵper uyiraṇukkaḷ : tukaḷcūḻ uyiraṇuk kaḷaiyuṭaiya kurutiyōṭṭa maṇṭalattiṉ periya piramiṭu vaṭiva ceṟivumikka uyiraṇukkaḷ. ivai īraliṉ elumpu uṭpuḻaiyiṉ uḷvarippūccāka amaintirukkum. itu, jermaṉ uṭal uṭkūṟiyalaṟiñar kārl vāṉkupḵper peyarāl aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu. kur : maiya narampu nōy : maiya narampu maṇṭalattil mella mella uṇṭākum kirumi nōy. itu maṉita iṟaicciyai uṇpatāl uṇṭākiṟatu. niyūkiṉiyil malaivāḻ makkaḷiṭam perumpālum ēṟpaṭukiṟatu.

Kuru : kuru/ciṟai nōy : maraṇam viḷaivikkakkūṭiya narampiyal ciṟai nōy. niyūkiṉiyiluḷḷa melaṉēciya marapuk kuḻuviṉaril maṉitap paṇpukaḷai niṉaivūṭṭum iyalpuṭaiya pālkuṭi uyiriṉaṅkaḷāl itu paravukiṟatu. 'kuru' eṉpataṟku avarkaḷ moḻiyil kāyccal allatu kuḷir mūlam ēṟpaṭum naṭukkam eṉṟu poruḷ. itaṉāl ciṟumūḷait taḷḷāṭṭam, naṭukkam, vāykkuḷaṟal ēṟpaṭṭu, paṭippaṭiyāka iyakka narampu vātam uṇṭāki, iṟutiyil maraṇam viḷaiyum.

oxidant : ākcikaraṇap poruḷ : or ākcikaraṇaip poruḷ. itu ākcijaṉaik koṇṭirukkum. anta ākcijaṉai mika eḷitāka vaḻaṅkum.

oxytocin : ākciṭṭōciṉ : piṉpuṟak kapaccurappu iyakku nīrkaḷil (hārmōṉ) oṉṟu. pāl curappu nāḷaṅkaḷil tacaiyaic curuṅkac ceytu, pāl curakkumpaṭi ceykiṟatu. ciṇṭōciṉāṉ eṉṟa kapac curappu nīrttayārippu, karuppaiyaic curuṅkac ceykiṟatu. eṉavē, itu makappēṟṟukkap piṉṉar ēṟpaṭum kurutikkacivai niṟattap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

oxyuris : nūlpūcci; nūl puḻu; kīrip pūcci : nīḷuruḷaip puḻu vakaiyil oṉṟu. itu potuvāka nūl puḻu eṉappaṭum.

itil uḷḷa miṉkalam mūlam kampi tūṇṭutal peṟṟu itayat tuṭippaic cīrākkukiṟatu. ikkaruvi poruttappaṭṭa cila nāṭkaḷil nōyāḷikaḷiṉ itayam mīṇṭum tāṉākavē taṉ paṇiyait toṭaṅkiviṭum. ikkaruvi 10 āṇṭukaḷ varai vēlai ceyyum.

palliation : kaṭumait taṇippu : nōyiṉ kaṭumaiyai maṭṭup paṭuttutal. palliative : nōyt taṇippu maruntu; vali nīkki; nōykkuṟi nīkkal : nōyai maṭṭuppaṭutta utavum maruntu. itu nōyait taṇikkumēyaṉṟik kuṇappaṭuttātu.

pailidotomy : mūḷai iṇaippu iḻai aṟuvai : mūḷait taṇṭuvaṭap puṟaṇikkum taṉi varippaḷḷattiṟkumiṭaiyilāṉa iṇaippu iḻaikaḷai aṟuvai maruttuvam mūlam tuṇṭittal. itu pārkkiṉcaṉ nōyil naṭukkattaik kuṟaikkac ceyyappaṭukiṟatu.

palm : uḷḷaṅkai; aṅkai : aṅkai varai mūṭum kaiyuṟai, aṅkai akalam ēṟattāḻa 10 ce.mī. uḷḷaṅkai nīḷam ēṟattāḻa 20 ce.mī.

palmar : uḷḷaṅkai cārnta : aṅkaiya uḷḷaṅkaiyiluḷḷa.

palmate (palmated) : uḷḷaṅkai vaṭivāṉa : uḷḷaṅkai vaṭivil uḷḷa.

palmitic acid : pālmiṭṭik amilam : perumpālāṉa eṇ ṇeykaḷilum, koḻuppukaḷilum kāṇappaṭum oru 16 kariya ceṟivuk koḻuppamilam.

palpable : toṭṭuṇarakkūṭiya; toṭṭaṟiyum; toṭṭuṇar : pulaṉkaḷāl eḷitil uṇarattakka uḷḷattāl aṟiyakkūṭiya.

palpation : kaic cōtaṉai; toṭṭaṟital; toṭṭuṇartal; toṭṭāytal : maruttuvattil kaiyāl toṭṭup paricōtaṉai ceytal.

palpebra : kaṇṇimai; imaikaḷ.

palpebra : kaṇṇimai cārnta; imaikkaṇ cavvu : kaṇṇi maikkuriya.

palpitation : neñcut tuṭippu; mārpup paṭapaṭappu : kaṭumuḻaippu, nōy kavalai kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭum aḷavukku mīṟiya neñcut tuṭippu.

paisy : muṭakkuvātam; vātam : uṭal uṟuppukaḷ muḻutum ceyalaṟṟuppōtal, uṇarvu keṭutal.

paludrine : pālūṭriṉ : purōkuvāṉil eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

pamaquin : pāmākkuviṉ : muṟaikkāyccal (malēriyā) nōykku etirākap payaṉ paṭuttappaṭum oru ceyaṟkai maruntu itu koyṉāvuṭaṉ allatu kuḷōkkuviṉuṭaṉ cērttuk koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu.

pamergan : pāmarkaḷ : pettiṭiṉ purōmettāciṉ iraṇṭum kalanta oru kalavaiyiṉ vaṇikap peyar. itu maruttuvac cikiccaikku muṉpu koṭukkap paṭukiṟatu.

panadol : paṉāṭōl : pārāciṭṭāmōl eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

panagglutinin : aṉaittut tiraṭṭi : ellā maṉita iratta vakaikaḷiṉ irattac civappaṇukkaḷai oṭṭit tiraḷac ceyyum oṭṭuttiraḷ etir miyam.

panagraphy : eksrē karuvikkuḷḷum, paṭakēciṭtāṭaiyaic cuṟṟilum vaittu paṭameṭuttu oru tāṭaiyil uḷḷa ellā paṟkaḷaiyum oru paṭattil pārttal.

panarthritis : muḻu mūṭṭu vātam; mūṭṭu aḻaṟci; muḻu mūṭṭaḻaṟci : oru muṭṭiṉ aṉaittuk kaṭṭamaippukaḷilum ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

pancake omentum : aṭaiyuru vayiṟṟuḷḷuṟai : enta oru puṟṟunōyum paravalāka ūṭuruvip paraviyataṉ kāraṇamāka, vayiṟṟu uḷḷuṟai mikavum taṭittuk kaṭiṉamātal.

pancarditis : itaya aḻaṟci; muḻu itaya aḻaṟci :' itayattiṉ ellāk kaṭṭamaippukaḷilum uṇṭākum vīkkam.

Pancoast's tumour : pēṉ kōsṭ kaṭṭi : nuraiyīraliṉ ucci maṭalaip paṟṟiya mūccuk kuḻāyp puṟṟu mēlnōkki vaḷarntu appakka mēṟkai narampup piṉṉalaiyum kaḻuttup parivu narampuc caṅkilit tokutiyaiyum tākkutal.

pancolectomy : muḻupperuṅkuṭal nīkkam : muḻupperuṅ kuṭalaiyum aṟuvai nīkkuvatōṭu, piṉ ciṟukuṭalil tuḷaiyuṇṭākki veḷikkoṇartal.

pancreas : kaṇaiyam : iraip paiyiṉ arukiluḷḷa, ceri

māṉattiṟkuriya nīr curakkum oru curappi. itu nākku pōṉṟa vaṭivuṭaiyatu. itaṉ talaip pakutiyai muṉ ciṟu kuṭal cūḻntirukkum. itaṉ vālpakuti maṇṇiralait toṭṭuk koṇṭirukkum. itu cumār 18 ce.mī. nīḷamum, cumār 100 kirām eṭaiyum uṭaiyatu. itil iṉculiṉ eṉṟa iyakku nīrum (hārmōṉ) ciṟu kuṭalil koḻuppukaḷaiyum cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷ aṭaṅkiya kaṇaiya nīrum curakkiṉṟaṉa. pacreatectomy : kaṇaiya aṟuvai; kaṇaiya eṭuppu; kaṇaiya tuṇippi : kaṇaiyattai muḻuvatumāka allatu ataṉ oru pakutiyai aṟuttu eṭuttu viṭutal.

pancreatic : kaṇaiyam cārnta.

pancreatic digestion : kaṇaiyac cerimāṉam.

pancreatic extract : kaṇaiyac cāram.

pancreatic function test : kaṇaiya iyakkac cōtaṉai : itil lāviṉ kuḻāykaḷ, iraippaikkuḷḷum, muṉ ciṟukuṭaliṉ iraṇṭām paku tikkuḷḷum cerukappaṭukiṟatu. muṉ ciṟukuṭaliṉ uyirp poliyai pakuppāyvu ceytu, kaṇaiyac curappiyiṉ palvēṟu iyakku nīrt tūṇṭutalkaḷiṉ viḷaivukaḷ aḷaviṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

pancreatic juice : kaṇaiya nīr.

pancreaticoduodenostomy : kaṇaiya muṉ ciṟukuṭal tuḷaippu : kaṇaiya nāḷattai muṉ ciṟu kuṭalil vēṟoru iṭattil oṭṭiyiṇaittal.

pancreatin : kaṇaiya nīrmam : kaṇayattiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷiṉ (eṉcaim) oru kalavai. kaṇaiya nōykaḷukkup payaṉ paṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

pancreatitis : kaṇaiya aḻaṟci : kaṇaiyattil uṇṭākum vīkkam. innōyai aṟiya irattattilum ciṟunīrilum uḷḷa lippēs aḷavu payaṉ paṭukiṟatu.

pancreatoduoclenectomy : kaṇaiyamuṉ ciṟukuṭal aṟuvai nīkkam : kaṇaiyattiṉ talaip pakutiyaiyum attuṭaṉ ataic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa muṉ ciṟu kuṭal vaḷaivaiyum aṟuttu nīkkutal.

pancreozymin : kaṇaiya curappu ūkki : muṉciṟukuṭal cavvup paṭalattil karakkum or iyakkunīr (hārmōṉ). itu kaṇaiyac cerimāṉapporuḷkaḷ, kuṟippāka, amilēs, curappatait tūṇṭukiṟatu.

pancrex : pāṅkiraks : kaṇaiya nīrmattiṉ (pāṅkiriyāṭṭiṉ) vaṇikap peyar. pancuronium : tacait taḷartti : mayakkam koṭukkumpōtu tuṇai ceyyap payaṉpaṭuttap paṭum iyakkutacai taḷarvikkum maruntu.

pancystitis : muḻuppaiyaḻaṟci : ciṟunīrp paiyiṉ cuvar muḻuvataiyum pātittuḷḷa aḻaṟci.

pancytopaenia : kuruti aṇukkuṟai; muḻu uyiraṇukkuṟai : irattattil civappaṇukkaḷ, tukaḷ veḷḷaṇukkaḷ, taṭṭaṇukkaḷ kuṟaivāka irukkum nilai. elumpu maccaiyiṉ ceyaṟpāṭu maṭṭuppaṭuttap paṭumpōtu itu uṇṭākiṟatu.

pandemic : peruṅkoḷḷai nōy; pakuti muḻuvatum paravu nōy; pāriya nōy : oru nāṭu muḻuvatum allatu ulakam muḻuvatum paravum peruṅkoḷḷai nōy.

Pandy's test : pēṉṭiyiṉ cōtaṉai : haṅkēri nāṭṭu maṉanala maruttuvar kālmēṉ pēṉṭiyiṉ peyariṭappaṭṭa iccōtaṉaiyil, mūḷai taṇṭuvaṭa nīriluḷḷa kuḷāpu liṉ puratamiruppatai, 7% ḵpīṉāl cērppatāl ēṟpaṭum kalaṅkal nilaiyāl aṟivatu.

panencephalitis : muḻumūḷaiyaḻaṟci : mūḷaiyiṉ cāmpaṟ poruḷ, veṇporuḷ iraṇṭiṉ pātippāl ēṟpaṭum mūḷaiyaḻaṟci.

panendoscopy : muḻuppakuti aka nōkki : uṇavukkuḻal, iraippai, muḻu ciṟukuṭal ellāvaṟṟaiyum oru taṭavai cōtaṉaiyiṉpōtē iḻaik kāṭci akanōkkiyāl kāṇutal.

Paneth's cells : pēṉet aṇukkaḷ : jermāṉiya maruttuvar jōcaḵp pēṉettiṉ peyaraip peṟṟa, ciṟukuṭal kuḻal curappikaḷiṉ puṟattōliya iḻaimattiluḷḷa iyōciṉ niṟat tuṇukkukaḷaik koṇṭa perum aṇukkaḷ.

panhypopituitarism : muḻup piṭyūṭṭarikkuṟai curappi : muṉ pakutippiṭyūṭṭari curappiṉ aḻivāl, ellā muṉ piṭyūṭṭaric curappikaḷ illāmal pōvatu allatu kuṟaivāka irukkum oru nilai.

panhysterectomy : muḻukkaruppai nīkkam : kaḻuttup pakutiyum cērttuk karuppai muḻuvataiyum aṟuttu nīkkutal.

panhysterosaipingectomy : muḻu karuppai; karuppaikkuḻal aṟuvai nīkkam : karuppai, karuppaik kaḻuttu maṟṟum karuppaik kuḻal aṉaittaiyum aṟuttu nīkkutal. panic attack : tikil tākkam : tāṉiyaṅki narampiyakka viḷaivukaḷum pēracca uṇarvu mikutiyōṭu kavalaiyum tiṭīreṉṟu viṭṭuviṭṭu tīviramākat tākkutal.

panniculectomy : koḻupaṭala aṟuvai nīkkam : uṭal parumaṉāṉavarkaḷil vayiṟṟuk koḻuppai aṟuttu eṭuttal.

panniculitis : koḻu paṭala aḻaṟci : vayiṟṟumuṉ cuvariṉ tōlaṭik koḻuppaḻaṟci.

pannus : viḻi veṇpaṭalac curukkam; marai paṭalam : viḻi veṇpaṭalam kuḻāypōl curukkamaṭaital. itu perumpālum imaippaṭala ericcaluṭaṉ toṭarpuṭaiyatu.

panography : akalparappu paṭavaraivu : orē paṭattil, muḻu paltokutiyaiyum muḻumaiyākak kāṭci peṟa payaṉpaṭuttum eksrē paṭameṭukkum toḻilnuṭpam.

panopthalmitis : viḻit ticu aḻaṟci; muḻukkaṇṇaḻaṟci : kaṇ viḻiyiṉ ticukkaḷ aṉaittilum ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

panosteitis : elumpu vīkkam : elumpu maccai, elumput ticu, elumpukaḷai mūṭiyuḷḷa cavvu pōṉṟa elumpiṉ amaippāṉkaḷ aṉaittum vīkka maṭaital.

pant : mūccut tiṇaṟal.

pantigridle syndrome : kaṇukkāl vīkkam : iṟukkamāṉa kuṟuṅkāl caṭṭai aṇiyum peṇkaḷ uṭkārntē oru nāḷ vēlai ceytapiṟaku, avarkaḷiṉ kaṇukkālkaḷil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

pantothenic acid : pēṇṭōtteṉik amilam : vaiṭṭamiṉ pi. tokutiyiṉ orukūṟu.

PAO : ucca amila uṟpatti.

pO2 : nuraiyīral tamaṉi ākcijaṉ pūritam : nuraiyīral tamaṉi ākcijaṉ pūritam maṟṟum aḻuttam.

papain : pēppeyiṉ : purataṅkaḷaiyum pālipeṭṭaiṭukaḷaiyum (amaiṉōpurataṅkaḷ) nīrāy pakuppu ceyya kiriyā ūkkiyākap payaṉpaṭum, oruvakai pappāḷiyiliruntu kiṭaikkum puratappiḷappu noti.

Papaincolaou test : peppāṉi kōlō cōtaṉai : pēp taṭavukai kirēkka amerikka maruttuvar jārj peppāṉi kōlāval vivarikkappaṭṭa cōtaṉai karuppaik kaḻuttiṉ cetiḷaṇuppuṟṟu maṟṟum piṟaḻ vaḷarcciyaiyum kaṇṭu piṭikka, karuppaik kaḻuttuc cītattiṉ mātiri eṭuttu aṇuc cōtaṉai ceytal. papovaviridae : peppōvā vairiṭā : puṟṟuṇṭākkum āṟṟal aṭaṅkiya peppōvā vairaskaḷ. pēppillōmā vairaskaḷ, pāliyōmā vairaskaḷ maṟṟum cimiyaṉ vairas 40 (SW40) ivvakaiyil aṭaṅkum.

Pappenheimer bodies : pēppaṉ hīmar meymaṅkaḷ : amerikka uyirvētiyiyalāḷar peyarāl aḻaikkappaṭum cevvaṇukkaḷiluḷḷa ciṟu irumpuḷḷa nila niṟamēṟṟum tuṇukkukaḷ.

paptest : puṟṟanōyc cōtaṉai : kaḻuttup pakutiyiluḷḷa puṟap paṭal uyiraṇukkaḷiṉ oru tiraḷai eṭuttuc cāyamēṟṟi, nuṇṇōkkāṭiyil paricōtaṉai ceytu, toṭakkanilaip puṟṟunōy irukkiṟatā eṉpataik kaṇṭaṟivataṟkāṉa cōtaṉai.

papaveretum : apiṉik kalavai : 50% mārḵpiṉ aṭaṅkiyuḷḷa apiṉi veṭiyakak kalappup poruḷkaḷiṉ kalavai.

papaverine : pāpāveriṉ : apiṉi veṭiyakak kalappup poruḷkaḷil caṟṟu mukkiyattuvam kuṟainta oru poruḷ; icippu, īḷai nōy, veḷic celkuḻāyk kōḷāṟukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟil taḷarcciyūṭṭum maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

papila : kāmpuk kumiḻ cataik kāmpu; nuṇkāmpu; cimpu; muḷai : kāmpu pōṉṟa nuṇṇiya mukiḻ pōṉṟa uṟuppu.

papillitis : cataik kāmpu vīkkam; nuṇkāmpu aḻaṟci : ḵpiṉāciṭ ṭiṉ eṉṟa maruntai aḷavukku mīṟi uṭkoṇṭāl, ciṟunīrakattil cataikkāmpu vīkkam ēṟpaṭalām.

papillary muscle : aṭukkut tacai : cimput tacaikaḷ.

papilloedema : kaṇ kumiḻ aḻaṟci; vaṭṭu vīkkam : kaṇ kumiḻil ēṟpaṭum iḻaima aḻaṟci. itu uḷ maṇṭaiyōṭṭil aḻuttam atikarit tiruppataik kuṟikkum.

papilloma : kaṇkumiḻ kaṭṭi; ciḷaikkum kaṭṭi; nuṇkāmpuk kaṭṭi : curappiyallāta kaḻuttup puṟappaṭalap pakutiyil uṇṭākum ilēcāṉa kaṭṭi.

papillomatosis : tōl kaṭṭi : tōlil allatu caḷiccavvil ēṟpaṭum ukkiramaṟṟa vaḷarcci. itaṉai lēcarmūlam akaṟṟalām.

papule : koppuḷam; paru : tōlil ēṟpaṭum ciṟiya vaṭṭa vaṭivap paru.

papulopustular : koppuḷam cārnta; cīḻkkoppuḷa : koppuḷaṅkaḷ, cīḻkkoppuḷaṅkaḷ cārnta. paraaminobenzoic acid : pārāmiṉōpeṉcāyik amilam : cūriya oḷiyiliruntu puṟavūtāk katirkaḷai vaṭikaṭṭum amilam. itu kaḷimpu allatu kaḻuvu nīrma vaṭivilum kiṭaikkiṟatu; itu veyililiruntu pātukāppaḷikkiṟatu.

paraaminosalicylic acid (PAS) : pārāmiṉōcālicilik amilam : kācanōykku etirākap payaṉ paṭuttappaṭum maruntu aicōṉiyāciṭ allatu sṭirapṭōmaiciṉ maruntuṭaṉ cērttukkoṭukkappaṭukiṟatu.

paraanaesthesia : kīḻuṭampu uṇarviḻappu : uṭampiṉ kīḻppakuti uṇarviḻappu.

paraaortic : peruntamaṉi arukiluḷḷa : itayattiṟku iṭatu mēlaṟaiyiliruntu puṟappaṭum peruntamaṉi eṉṟa irattak kuḻāyiṉ arukil iruppatu.

paraaortic body : makātamaṉip pakka meymam : vayiṟṟumakā tamaṉippakkattil amaintu uḷḷa ciṟu kurōmēṭṭiṉ ticuttiraḷkaḷil oṉṟu.

parabiosis : para uyir iraṭṭaikaḷ : 1. oṭṭippiṟanta iraṭṭaik kuḻantaikaḷ pōl iru uyirkaḷ oṉṟiṇaital, 2. kaṭattu tiṟaṉum kiḷartiṟaṉum taṟkālikamāka taṭaippaṭṭu iruttal.

paracentesis : vaṭituḷaiyiṭal : uṭaṟkuḻivaṟai oṉṟai veḷi yiliruntu oru ūciyāl allatu oru tuḷaikkum karuviyāl tuḷaittu uḷḷirukkum nīrai, nōyaṟivataṟkāka allatu maruttuvattukkāka veḷiyi leṭukkum muṟai.

paracetamol : pārāciṭṭāmōl : oru meṉmaiyāṉa nōvakaṟṟum maruntu. itu vīkkattaik kuṟaippatillai. muṭakku vātaṅkaḷukku itu payaṉpaṭātu. itaṉai atika aḷavil uṭkoṇṭāl nuraiyīralukkuk kaṭuñcētam viḷaiyum.

parachute mitral valve : vāṉkuṭaiyuku īritaḻ taṭukkitaḻ (vālvu) : īritaḻ vālviṉ iru ciṟṟitaḻkaḷiṉ tacai nāriḻaikaḷ iṭatu itayak kīḻaṟaiyiṉ kāmpurutta tacaikaḷil cerukiyiruppatāl kurutiyōṭṭat tukkut taṭai ēṟpaṭuttal.

paraclinical : maruttuvam cārnta maruntiyal : nōykkuṟiyiyal, nuṇṇuyiriyal, caṭṭa maruttuvayiyal pōṉṟa oru maruttuvap paṭippuk kālattil pāti nilaiyil paṭikkum pāṭaṅkaḷ.

paracodo : pārākkōṭāl : kōṭaiṉ kalanta pārāciṭ ṭōmāl eṉṟa karaiyakkūṭiya māttiraikaḷiṉ vaṇikappeyar.

paradigm : karutturu nilai : karutturu viḷakkak koḷkaiyai otticaiyum taravukaḷ cērvatāl, oru kuṟippiṭṭa uyirvētiyiyal tattuvattiṉ paravalāka ēṟṟuk koḷḷappaṭum viḷakkaṅkaḷ ēṟṟuk koḷḷappaṭutal.

paradoxical sleep : kaṉavu uṟakkam : uṟaṅkum nērattiṉpōtu viraivāṉa kaṇṇacaivukaḷ ēṟpaṭum; appōtu kaṉavukaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa.

paraesthesia : mikai ūṟuṇarvu : maṭṭumīṟiya toṭu uṇarvu.

paraffin : nilameḻuku kaṉmeḻuku : kaḷimaṇṇuṭaṉ kalleṇ ṇeyaik kalantu kiṭaikkum meḻuku. tirava nila meḻuku pēti maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. veṇṇiṟamāṉa meṉ nilameḻuku kaḷimpu maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. tiṇṇiya nilameḻuku vātaṅkaḷukkup pūcci maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. nilameḻuku eṇṇey viḷakku erikkavum, macakup poruḷākavum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

paraffinoma : meḻukurukkaṭṭi : toṭarntu meḻuku paṭivatāl uṇṭākum. (kuruḷai) ticuk kaṭṭi.

paraformaldehyde : pārāḵpār malṭihaiṭ : iṟantavar uṭaṟ kuḻāykaḷil irukkum ciṟu kuḻalkaḷil nōy nuṇmam nīkkavum, aṟaikaḷai toṟṟut taṭai nīkkam ceyyavum payaṉpaṭum tiṭaporuḷ.

paragesic : pārājecik : nōvakaṟṟum oru kalavaip poruḷiṉ vaṇikap peyar. itu, valiyuṇṭākkum mēl mūccaṭaippukkup payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

paragonimiasis : pārākōṉi masmoyppu : pārākōṉimas iṉam cārnta oṭṭuṇṇip puḻuttākkam. nuraiyīralil vesṭarmaṉai tākkattāl ēṟpaṭum nīrkkaṭṭikaḷāl kōḻaiyil kuruti veḷiyāvatōṭu viral muṉaikaḷ taṭittal, kallīralum mūḷaiyum pātikkappaṭalām. maruttuvam ceyya pirēcikuviṇṭāl maruntu tarappaṭukiṟatu.

paragonimus : pērākōṉimas : nuraiyīral vāḻum oṭṭuṇṇik kokkip puḻukkaḷ iṉattil atikamākak kāṇappaṭuvatu pērākōṉimas pesṭermaṉai eṉṉum iṉamākum. avaṟṟiṉ muṭṭaikaḷ irumal caḷi allatu malattiṉ vaḻiyāka veḷiyēṟṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. anta muṭṭaikaḷiliruntu taṇṇīril muṭṭaip puḻukkaḷ veḷippaṭṭu putu nīr nattaikaḷil nuḻaikiṉṟaṉa. nattaiyiliruntu veḷippaṭum muṭṭaippuḻu naṇṭukaḷil nīrkkaṭṭi vaṭivam peṟukiṉṟaṉa. anta nilaiyil avai appaṭiyē allatu cariyāka camaikkāmal uṇpavarkaḷai puḻukkaḷ moykkiṉṟaṉa.

parahaemophilia : kuruti oḻukku nōy : kurutiyuraikāraṇi 2 havāl paramparai kuruti oḻukkuttaṉmai.

parainflunenzavirus : ūṉīr nōyk kirumi : ūṉīr nōyk kirumikaḷil oṉṟu. itu mēl mūccuk kōḷāṟiṉai uṇṭākkukiṟatu vairas kirumikaḷil oruvakai.

parakeratosis : tōl acaikkaru muṉpaṭalap pāval.

paralaia : pēccoli piṟaḻvu; pitaṟṟal : oru eḻuttai vaḻakkamāka māṟṟi uccarikkum pēccuk kuṟai.

paraldehyde : pārālṭihaiṭ : tūkkamuṭṭum iyalpuḷḷa oru tiravam. kuḷōrāl haiṭrēṭ pōṉṟa kuṇamuṭaiyatu. āliv eṇṇeyk karaicailāka vāyvaḻiyākavum narampūci vaḻiyākavum koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. ippōtu itu aritākavē payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. vilaṅkukaḷukku mayakkamūṭṭap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

parallergy : para ovvāmai : oru kuṟippiṭṭa ovvāmai ūk kipporuḷāl mikuuṇarvukku āṭpaṭṭatāl, enta oru tūṇṭalālum pātippukku uḷḷākakkūṭiya uṭaliṉ ovvāmai nilai.

paralysis : muṭakkuvātam; pakkavātam; vātam ceyaliḻappu : narampu ceyaliḻappataṉ kāraṇamāka uṭaliṉ oru pakuti muḻumaiyāka allatu pakutiyākac ceyaliḻattal. itu uṇarvu narampu cārntatākavō allatu iyakku narampu cārntatākavō allatu iraṇṭum cārntatākavō irukkalām.

paralytic : vātanōyāḷi; vāta : muṭakkuvāta nōy uṭaiyavar; pakkavāta nōyāḷi; iyakka āṟṟal iḻantavar.

paralyticileus : kuṭaliyakkakkuṟai : vayiṟṟaṟuvai, vayiṟṟuḷ ḷuṟaiyaḻaṟci poṭṭāciyak kuṟaikuruti nilai pōṉṟa miṉ ayaṉip piṟaḻ nilaikaḷil kuṭali alaiviyakkam kuṟai paṭum allatu taṭaipaṭum nilai. ﻿paramedian : maiyam cārnta; maiyattarukil : maiyappakuti arukiluḷḷa.

paramedian incision : naṭukkōṭṭup pakkakkīṟal : vayiṟṟu naṭukkōṭṭiliruntu 1-2.5 ce.mī. taḷḷi ceṅkuttākakkīṟi, nērttacaiyai veḷippakkam taḷḷi vaittal.

paramedic : tuṇaimaruttuvap paṇiyāḷar : oru vipattiṟkup piṉ avacara maruttuva kavaṉippu aḷittu uyir mīṭkum payiṟci peṟṟa āḷ.

paramedical : maruttuvañcār toḻil; maruttuva utaviyāḷar : maruttuvat toḻiluṭaṉ toṭarpuṭaiya toḻil muṟaip payiṟci, uṭaṟpayiṟci, pēccup payiṟci, maruttuvac camūkattoṇṭu ākiyavai ivvakaiyiṉa.

paramenstruum : mātaviṭāyk kālam : mātaviṭāy toṭaṅkuvataṟku muntiya nāṉku nāṭkaḷum mātaviṭāyiṉ mutal nāṉku nāṭkaḷum mātaviṭāy kālam eṉappaṭum.

parametrium : karuppai iṇaipputticu; karuppaip pakkam : karuk paiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa iṇaipput ticukkaḷ.

paramo : pārāmōl : pārāciṭṭāmōl, ṭaihaiṭirōk kōṭaiṉ iraṇṭum kalanta kalavai maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar ilēcāṉa valiyaik kaṭṭuppaṭutta vāyvaḻi uṭkoḷḷappaṭukiṟatu.

paramucin : pērāmyūciṉ : muṭṭaippai nīrkkaṭṭiyilum maṟṟa nīrkkaṭṭikaḷilum kāṇappaṭum paḻaccīṉip puratam. atu nīril karaivatillai. āṉāl ṭēṉṉiṉ cērttāl aṭiyil paṭikiṟatu.

parmyxoviridae : pērāmiksō mānaccuyirkaḷ : pērāmiksōmā naccuyir, mārpili naccuyir, niyūmō naccuyir pōṉṟa iṉaṅkaḷai uḷḷaṭakkiya ār.eṉ.ē. naccuyir kuṭumpam.

paramyxovirus : pērāmiksō naccuyir : mūccup pātait toṟṟukaḷ, taṭṭammai, puṭṭālammai ākiya nōykaḷai uṇṭākkum pērāmiksō naccuyir kuṭumpattaic cērnta ōriṉa naccuyir.

paranasal : mūkkukkuḻi arukil; mūkkarukil; nācippakkam.

paraneoplastic : parapuṟṟunilai : oru kaṭṭi allatu ataṉ cēymap paraval tiraḷiliruntu tūrattil ticukkaḷil uṇṭākum māṟṟaṅkaḷ. paranephritis : ciṟunīrakap pakkat ticuvaḻaṟci : 1. ciṟunīrakattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa iṇaitticu aḻaṟci 2. aṇṇīrakac curappi aḻaṟci.

paramoia : tiripuṇarvu; karuttut tiripunōy; tuṉpuṟu maṉanōy : aṟivup piṟaḻcciyum, tarukkiyal cittappiramaiyum ēṟpaṭum oruvakai maṉakkōḷāṟu.

paranoid behaviour : aiyuṟavu naṭattai : maṟṟavarkaḷ mītu aiyuṟavu koḷḷum ceyalkaḷ.

paranoid personality : aṟivu piṟaḻ āṉmai : aiyappāṭṭu mikuuṇarvu allatu valiyat tākkum iyalpuṭaiya oruvar.

paranoidschizophrenia : aiyuṟavu muraṇ mūḷai nōy : maruṭciyum, māyakkāṭcikaḷum aṭikkaṭi ēṟpaṭum oruvakai muraṇmūḷai nōy.

paranomia : peyarmaṟati : pārkkum poruḷkaḷiṉ cariyāṉa peyarkaḷai niṉaivil vaittuk koḷḷa muṭiyāta pēccu muṟai kōḷāṟu.

paranychia : naka aḻaṟci (viralcuṟṟi) nakaccuṟṟu; nakattaṭi cīḻkkaṭṭi : viral nakattaic cuṟṟi ēṟpaṭum vīkkam. itu pākṭīriyāviṉāl allatu pūñcaṇattiṉāl uṇṭākiṟatu.

paraoesphageal : uṇavuk kuḻāy arukil : uṇkuḻal pakkam.

parapertusis : parivuk kakkuvāṉ : kaṭumaiyillāta kakkuvāṉ irumal nōy.

paraphimosis : āṇkuṟimukai curukkaḻuttam : iṟukkamāṉa nuṉittōlai piṉṉiḻukkum pōtu āṇkuṟimukai curukkaḻuttappaṭṭu vīkkamum valiyum ēṟpaṭukiṟatu.

paraphrenia : maruṭcinōy : mutiyavarkaḷukku uṇṭākum oruvakai uḷaviyal nōy. itaṉāl oruvita māyattōṟṟam (maruṭci) potuvākat tāṉ viṭātu uṟuttappaṭuvatāka oru maruṭci ēṟpaṭum.

paraplasm : parakaṇiyam : 1. piṟaḻ vaḷarcci. 2 oru uyiraṇuviṉ muṉkaṇiyam (uyirkkūḻmam).

paraplegia : kīḻ uṟuppup pakka vātam; uṭal kīḻpātivātam; kīḻaṅka vātam : uṭaliṉ kīḻp pakuti uṟuppukaḷil, kuṟippāka malakkuṭal, ciṟunīrppai pōṉṟavaṟṟil ēṟpaṭum pakkavāta nōy.

parapraxia : parapirākciyā : poruḷkaḷai iṭam māṟṟi vaittāl, col piṟaḻcci pōṉṟa poruḷuḷḷa ceyalkaḷai cariyillāmal ceytal.

paraprotein : parapuratam : iyalpāṉa pakutiyāyillāta, nōy nilaiyil irattam allatu ciṟunīril perumaḷavil kāṇappaṭum palavakai purataṅkaḷ.

paraproteinaemia : parapuratak kurutimai : kuruticcīr aṇu nōykaḷil irattattil kāṇappaṭum iyalpallāp purataṅkaḷ.

parapsoriasis : paracentaṭippu : avvappōtu peritākum taḻumpil nilaipeṟṟa nāḷ paṭṭa karumpuḷḷi koppuḷamāka cetiḷāṉa centaṭippu.

parapsycholgy : pulaṉuṇarviyal : pulaṉuṇarvu kaṭanta nōkku. tolaiviluṇartal pōṉṟa uḷaviyal nikaḻvukaḷ paṟṟi ārāytal, puṟa uḷaviyal tuṟai.

paraquat : parākkuvāṭ : oru vakaip puḻukkolli maruntu. itaṉai uṭkoṇṭāl, kāla tāmatamāka nuraiyīral īraṟ kulai, ciṟunīrakam ākiyavaṟṟil naccut taṉmai uṇṭākum. itaṉāl paṭippaṭiyāka nuraiyīral kāyccal (nimōṉiyā) ēṟpaṭṭu maraṇam viḷaiyalām.

pararectal : malakkuṭal arukil.

parasitaemia : kuruti oṭṭuṇṇi; oṇṭuṇṇiyam : kurutiyil paravi oṭṭuṇṇikaḷ niṟaintiruttal.

parasite : oṭṭuṇṇi : maṟṟoru tāy uyiriyiṭamiruntu uṇavai uṟiñcivāḻum or oṭṭuyiri.

parasitic diseases : oṭṭuṇṇi nōykaḷ : oṭṭuṇṇi uyiri kaḷiṉāl uṇṭākum nōykaḷ.

parasitic foetus : oṭṭuyir mutirkaru : iraṭṭaik kuḻantai mutir karukkaḷil oṉṟil itayam uruvākāmal iyalpāṉa iraṭṭaikaḷil oṉṟiṉ iratta cuḻaṟciyaik koṇṭu uyir tarittiruppatu.

parasiticide : oṭṭuyirkkolli; oṭṭuṇṇik kolli; oṭṭumuṟi : oṭṭuṇṇi uyirkaḷaik kollum maruntu.

parasuicide : pōlit taṟkolai : taṟkolai ceytu koḷḷap pōtuvatupōl pōliyāka naṭittal, maṉa nōyāḷikaḷāka illāta āṉāl maṉa uḷaiccalukku āṭpaṭṭa iḷaiñarkaḷ ivvāṟu ceykiṟārkaḷ.

parasitism : oṭṭuyir tākkam : 1. oru oṭṭuyir moyppu. 2. ompum uyiriṭamiruntu oṭṭu uyir palaṉ peṟṟu iru uyirkaḷum oṉṟāka vāḻum uṟavu nilai.

paraspadias : āṇkuṟip pakkat tuḷaiyamaivu : ciṟunīrt tārai āṇ kuṟittaṇṭiṉ oru pakkap pakutiyil tiṟakkum piṟavik kōḷāṟu.

parasympathetic nervous system : iṇaip parivu narampu maṇṭalam : maiya narampu maṇṭalattaic cērnta maṇṭaiyōṭu maṟṟum iṭuppuk kuḻi iṇai elumpu cārnta narampukaḷ cilavaṟṟiliruntu varum tāṉiyaṅkum narampu maṇṭalattiṉ oru pakuti.

parasympatholytic : tuṇaipparivu narampuc camaṉa maruntu : tuṇaipparivu narampu maṇṭalat tūṇṭutalai camaṉappaṭuttum maruntu.

parasynapsis : pakka iṇaippu : kuṉṟal piriviṉpōtu iṉa niṟak kīṟṟukaḷ pakkam pakkamāka oṉṟiṇaital.

parasystole : para(pakkac) curukkam : vaḻakkamāṉa muṟaiyāṉa itayat tuṭippukkuk kāraṇamāṉa itayap pakutiyait tavirtta tuṇaiyatika tūṇṭal mūlam.

parathion : pārāttiyāṉ : oru karimap pāsḵpēṭ vēḷāṇ maiyil oru pūccikolli maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. kōliṉes ṭirācukku etirākat tīviramākac ceyaṟpaṭak kūṭiyatu. itaṉālēyē maṉi tarukkukkēṭu viḷaivikkak kūṭiyatu.

parathormone : pārāttōrmōṉ : tuṇaikkēṭayac curappiyil curakkum ōr iyakku nīr (hārmōṉ). itu, irattattil kālciyattiṉ aḷavaic camaṉappaṭuttukiṟatu.

parathyroid : pērātairāyṭu : 1. tairāyṭu curappikkup pakkattil amaintuḷḷatu. 2. tairāyiṭu curappip poruḷukkuḷ potintuḷḷa allatu ataṉ kīḻ oram allatu piṉ pakutiyil amaintuḷḷa nāṉku ciṟu nāḷamillāc curappikaḷil oṉṟu. kālciyam, ḵpāsparas vaḷarcitaiyattai oḻuṅkupaṭuttum pērātairāyiṭu iyakkunīrai, avai curakkiṉṟaṉa.

parathyroid glands : tuṇaik kēṭayac curappikaḷ; iṇait tairāyṭuc curappikaḷ : kēṭayac curappiyiṉ piṉpuṟapparappil uḷḷa nāṉku ciṟiya nāḷa millāc curappikaḷ. itu, pārāttōrmōṉ eṉṉum iyakkunīraic (hārmōṉ) curakkiṟatu.

parathyroidectomy : tuṇaik kēṭayac curappi aṟuvai : tuṇaikkēṭayac curappikaḷil oṉṟai allatu ataṟku mēṟ paṭṭavaṟṟai aṟuvai maruttuvam mūlam veṭṭiyeṭuttal.

parathyrotropic : parātairāyiṭu nūṇma : parātairāyṭu curappiyait tūṇṭum (iyakkunīr).

paratope : parapakuti : etir ūkkiyōṭu oṭṭikkoḷḷum etirpporuḷ pakuti.

paratracheal : mūccukkuḻāy arukil : kuralvaḷai arukil.

paratuberculosis : paraṭiyūpar kuḷōcis : maikō pēkṭīriyam ṭiyūparkulōcis kirumiyāl allātu uṇṭākum ṭiyūparkulōcis pōṉṟa nōy.

paratyphoid : paraṭaiḵpāyiṭu : cālmoṉellā pārāṭaiḵpai 'ē' maṟṟum 'pi' kirumikaḷāl uṇṭākum ṭaipāyiṭu nōyiṉ mitamāṉa vakai.

paratyphoid fever : iḷaik kuṭaṟkāyccal : kuṭaṟkāyccal (ṭaiḵpāyṭu) pōṉṟa oru kāyccal nōy. itu kuṭaṟkāyccalaiviṭak kaṭumai kuṟaintatu; itaṉ kāla nīṭciyum kuṟaivu. oru vakai "cālmōṉellā" eṉṟa nōyk kirumiyiṉāl uṇṭākiṟatu.

paraurethral : ciṟunīrppuṟavaḻi arukil : mūttira oḻukkuk kuḻāy arukil.

paravaccinia : pērāvākciṉiyā nōy : pacukkaḷiṉ pāl maṭiyai pātikkum pērāvākciṉiyā vairas nōy.

paravaginitis : yōṉippakkatticu aḻaṟci : yōṉiyiṉ pakkaṅ kaḷiluḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

paravaginal : yōṉikkuḻay arukil; alkul arukil : peṇṇiṉ karuppai vāyk kuḻāyiṉ arukil.

paravertebral : taṇṭuvaṭam arukil; muḷḷelumpukkarukil : mutukantaṇṭiṉ arukil.

paragoric (paragoric elixir) : cūṭa āpiṉit tailam : cūṭaṉ, cōmpu, cāmpirāṇi maṇaṅkaḷ ūṭṭapaṭṭu apiṉi karainta cārāyattiṉalāṉa nōvakaṟṟum maruntu. paḻaiya kālattil atikamākap payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

pareira : ciṟunīr vēr maruntu : ciṟu nīrkkōḷāṟukaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum pirēcil nāṭṭu vērccarakku maruntu.

parenchyma : cōṟṟutticu : curappik karupporuḷ, or uṟuppiṉ karupporuḷ aṇukkaḷ. parenteral : vaḻiyāyallāta : cerippumaṇṭala vaḻiyāyallāmal vēṟu vaḻiyil uṭalukkuḷ, maruntukaḷ, ūṭṭap poruṭkaḷ allatu maṟṟa poruṭkaḷai celuttuvatu.

parenteral fluid therapy : ciraivaḻit tirava maruttuvam; ūci mūlam maruntēṟṟal : iraippai kuṭal vaḻiyākap pōtiya ūṭṭac cattiṉai aḷikka iyalātirukkumpōtu, neñcup paikkuḷ kuruti koṇṭu cellum kuḻāyākiya ciraiyiṉ vaḻiyāka ūṭṭac cattiṉaic celuttum muṟai. itil, nōy nuṇmam nīkkiya oru karaical iṟakkum kuḻāyiṉai oru periya maiyac ciraiyil uḷḷa ceruki coṭṭuc coṭṭākac cattupporuḷ uṭ celuttap paṭukiṟatu. viṉāṭikku ettaṉai coṭṭu celkiṟatu eṉpatai or iṟaippāṉ kaṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟatu.

paresis : araikuṟai muṭakku vātam; tacaivātam; ūṉavātam; iyakkak kuṟaivu : tacai iyakkattai maṭṭum taṭaiceytu, uṇarcciyait taṭaiceyyāta pakkavātam.

paresthesia : parauṇarvu nilai : tōlil kūriya kūcca uṇarvu. ūciyāl kuttuvatu pōṉṟa uṇarvu.

parietal : ucci maṇṭai elumpu : maṇṭaiyōṭṭiṉ uccippak kaṅkaḷukkuriya iṇai elumpukaḷuḷ oṉṟu.

parietal bone : maṇṭaiyuccip pakka elumpu : maṇṭaiyōṭṭiṉ pakkaṅkaḷukkuriya iṇai elumpukaḷ.

parietofrontal : maṇṭaiyōṭṭiṉ uccippakka : muṉ talai neṟṟi elumpukaḷ, mūḷai maṭippukaḷ, piḷavukaḷ toṭarpāṉa.

Parinaud's syndrome : parināṭu nōyiyam : ḵpireñcu kaṇ maruttuvar hecpariṉāṭu peyarālmamainta naṭumūḷai nōy nilaiyāl, virumpiya paṭi pārvaiyilēyō allatu kīḻō tiruppamuṭiyāta nilai.

parite : pariṭṭē : tamaṉi nār iṟukkattil tamaṉikkuḷḷa koḻunārppaṭivu.
