perikaryon : perikariyōṉ : 1. uyirkkaruvaic cūḻntuḷḷa aṇuk(kūḻmam) kaṇiyam. 2. acciḻai maṟṟum iḻaimap pirivukaḷiliruntu muṟṟilum vēṟupaṭṭa narampaṇuviṉ aṇu meymam, 3. palluru iḻai tavirtta, (vērk) kāḻk karukkaḷ.

perikymata : perikkaimāṭṭā : putitāka muḷaitta paṟkaḷiṉ cippiyiṉ mēl kāṇappaṭum kaṇakkaṟṟa kuṟukkukkōṭṭuk kuḻivukaḷ.

perilabyrinthitis : perilāpirintiṭṭīs : uṭcevivaḷaikuḻala maippaic cūḻntuḷḷa ticu vaḻaṟci. perilaryngitis : kuralvaḷai cuṟṟaḻaṟci : kuralvaḷaiyaic cūḻntu uḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perilymph : uṭcevip puṟananiṇanīr; cuṟṟu vaṭinīr : uṭceviyil elumput tuḷaikkum cavvut tuḷaikkum iṭaiyiluḷḷa nīrmam.

perilymphangitis : niṇanāḷac cuṟṟaḻaṟci : oru niṇanāḷattaic cūḻntuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perimetrium : karuppai melluṟai; karuppai cītappaṭaluṟai; karuppai puṟac cavvu : karuppaiyai mūṭiyuḷḷa nīraṭaṅkiya iraṭṭaic cavvuppai.

perimyelitis : maccaic cuṟṟaḻaṟci : 1. taṇṭuvaṭattiṉ cilantiyuru urai maṟṟum uḷḷuṟaiyaḻaṟci. 2. elumpiṉ maccaik kuḻi vaṟaiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa paṭala aḻaṟci.

perimyositis : tacaiccuṟṟaḻaṟci : oru tacaiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa iṇaipput ticuvaḻaṟci.

perimysitis : tacaiyiḻaināruṟaiyaḻaṟci : iyakku tacaiyiḻaik kaṭṭukaḷ ovvoṉṟaiyum cuṟṟiyuḷḷa nāruṟai aḻaṟci.

perimysium : nīḷattacai cūḻiṇaipput ticuppaṭalam : iyakku tacaiyiḻaikaḷiṉ mutaṉmaik kaṭṭukaḷ ovvoṉ ṟaic cūḻntuḷḷa nāruṟai.

perinatal : pēṟukālam; nāṉku vārakkaru : kuḻantai piṟappataṟku muntiya cila vāraṅkaḷukkum, kuḻantai piṟanta piṟaku cila vāraṅkaḷukkumiṭaippaṭṭa kāla aḷavu.

perinatology : kuḻantaiyiyal : mutirkaru maṟṟum puttiḷam kuḻantaiyiṉ piṟappuppiṉ kāla kavaṉippup paṟṟiya kuḻantai maruttuvattiṉ ciṟappup pakuti.

perineocoele : yōṉikkuḻāyp pitukkam : nērkuṭalukkum ciṟu nīrppaikkum allatu nērk kuṭalukkum yōṉittuḷaikkum iṭaiyē uḷḷa (toṭaiyiṭaip) maṟaiviṭap pakutiyil tōṉṟum pitukkam.

perineometer : yōṉikkuḻāy aḻuttamāṉi : iṭuppuk kuḻittaḷat tacaikaḷ curuṅkum valimaiyaip pativu ceyvataṟkākap peṇṇiṉ karuppai vāyk kuḻāyiṉuḷ (yōṉik kuḻāy) cerukappaṭum or aḻuttamāṉi.

perineorrhaphy : viṭapa iṇaippu aṟuvai; mūlātārat taippu : kiḻinta viṭapattai (ācaṉam) cīrpaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa aṟuvai maruttuvam. perineotomy : piṟappup pātai aṟuvai; mūlātāra veṭṭu : piṟappup pātaiyil aṟuvai maruttuvam ceytal; mēl veṭṭu aṟuvai.

perinephric : ciṟunīrakam cūḻnta; ciṟunīrakap puṟam : ciṟunīrakattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa.

perinephrium : ciṟunīrakaccuṟṟaḻaṟci : ciṟunīrakattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa koḻuppu, iṇaipput ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perineurium : narampuc cuṟṟaḻaṟci : oru maiyavilakiya narampiṉ taṉittaṉi iḻaikkaṭṭukaḷiṉ nāruṟai.

perineum : viṭapam; karuvāyc cūḻal; mūlattāṉam; mūlātāram; ācaṉam : peṇṇiṉ iṭuppuk kuḻiyiṉ veḷivāy, peṇpuṟavuṟuppu uḷḷiṭṭa uṭaṟpakuti iṭuppelumpu muṉpālap pakutikkuk kīḻē toṭaiyiṉ iṭaippakuti.

period : 1. vaḻakkamāka naṭai peṟum nikaḻvukaḷ allatu iyaṟkāṭcikaḷukkiṭaiyēyuḷḷa nēram, 2. peṇkaḷiṉ mātap pōkku 3. oru nōy allatu nōy nilai pātikkum nēram.

periodic breathing : iṭaiveḷi mūccōṭṭam : piṟanta kuḻantaikku 5-10 viṉāṭi nēram mūccu niṉṟu mīṇṭum mūccu varutal, mīṇṭum mūccu varum pōtu kuḻantai nimiṭattiṟku 50-60 taṭavai mūccuviṭum. itu 18-15 viṉāṭikaḷ nīṭikkum. mottattil nimiṭattiṟku 30-40 taṭavai mūccōṭṭam naṭaipeṟum viṭṭuviṭṭu mūccu.

periodicity : paruva nikaḻvu : vaḻakkamāka kuṟippiṭṭa iṭai vēḷaikaḷil tirumpa varum taṉmai.

periodontal : paṟpuṟam cārnta : pallaiccuṟṟi, paṟkāḻ paṟṟiya.

periodontics : paṟpuṟatticuviyal : paṟkaḷaic cuṟṟilum amaintu uḷḷa ticukkaḷaip paṟṟiya, pal maruttuvap pirivukaḷiṉ oru pāṭam.

periodontitis : paṟpuṟatticuvaḻaṟci : īṟukaḷiṉ aḻaṟci, pal elumpuc cuṟṟum paṟkuḻi elumpum kāraiyum tēyntaḻital pōṉṟavai nikaḻum pallaic cuṟṟilumiruntu tāṅkum ticukkaḷiṉ nōy. itaṉāl, īṟukaḷ tēyntu paṟkaḷ piṭippiḻantu āṭutal.

periodontal disease : paṟkuḻi nōy : paṟkuḻit ticukkaḷil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam. palliṉ vēraic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa cavvum, elumpum paṭippaṭiyāka nali vuṟuvatāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu. periodontium : paṟ puṟatticukkaḷ : paṟkaḷaic cuṟṟilumiruntu tāṅkum ticukkaḷ. avaiyāvaṉa, īṟukaḷ, paṟkārai, paṟcuṟṟup paṭalam maṟṟum palkuḻi elumpu.

periodontosis : paṟpuṟatticut tēyvu : paṟpuṟatticukkaḷ tēyn taḻivatāl paṟkaḷ āṭuvatum iṭampeyarvatum nikaḻtal.

perionychia : nakamaṭippu; vīkkam; nakattaṭic cīḻkkaṭṭi : nakamaṭippu kaḷaic cuṟṟic civappu niṟamāṉa valiyuṇṭākkum vīkkam ēṟpaṭutal. nīril atika nēram puḻaṅkum kaikaḷilum, irattavōṭṭam kuṟaivākavuḷḷa kaikaḷilum perumpālum ēṟpaṭukiṟatu. oru vakaip pūñcaṇak kirumi itaṟkuk kāraṇam. muṉpu intak kirumikaḷaik kaṭṭuppaṭutti vanta uyirikaḷai oṭukkiviṭum uyir etirp poruḷkaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl ippōtu uṇṭākiṟatu.

perioophoritis : (muṭṭaip) cūṟpaic cuṟṟaḻaṟci : muṭṭaip paiyaic cuṟṟilumuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perioperative : aṟuvai maruttuvak kālam : aṟuvai maruttuvam naṭaipeṟuṅkālattaiyum, aṟuvai maruttuvattukku muntiya pintiyakālaṅkaḷaiyum uḷḷaṭakkiya kāla aḷavu.

peripheral nervous system : puṟa narampu maṇṭalam.

perioptometry : pārvaip parappumāṉi : kāṭcip parappiṉ ellaikaḷai aḷattal.

perioral : vāyt tōl aḻaṟci; vāyaic cuṟṟi : vāyaic cuṟṟi uḷḷa tōlil ēṟpaṭum cenniṟac citaḷuṭaṉkūṭiya aḻaṟci. vayatuvanta iḷam peṇkaḷukku itu perumpālum uṇṭākiṟatu. muka oppaṉaip poruṭkaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl itu ēṟpaṭuvatākak karutappaṭukiṟatu.

periorbita : paṟkuḻiccuṟṟuppakuti : paṟkuḻi elumpukaḷiṉ eṉpuccuṟ ṟuppaṭalam paṟkuḻippaṭalam.

periosteomyelitis : elumpu maccaic cuṟṟaḻaṟci : elumpuṭaṉ eṉpu cuṟṟup paṭalam maṟṟum elumpu maccaiyiṉ aḻaṟci.

periosteum : elumpuc cavvu; elumpuṟai; elumpup puṟam : elumpukaḷai mūṭiyuḷḷa cavvu. elumpukaḷ putitāka vaḷarvataṟku intap pātukāppu iṉṟiyamaiyātatākum.

periostitis : elumpuc cavvaḻaṟci; elumpuṟai aḻaṟci : elumpu kaḷai muṭiyuḷḷa cavvil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

periostosis : elumpaḻaṟci : elumpu cuṟṟuppaṭalattil iyalpallāta elumpuppaṭivu. periotic : ceviccuṟṟu : 1. ceviyai, mukkiyamāka uṭceviyaic cuṟṟiyamaintuḷḷa, 2. poṭṭelumpiṉ mukaiyurup pakuti maṟṟum poṟaip pakutikaḷ.

peripartum : piṟappuk kālam : kuḻantai piṟakkum nēram. itaṉaip 'pēṟukālam' eṉpar. periphacitis : viḻivillaiḻiyuṟaiyaḻaṟci : kaṇoḷivillai mūṭi yuḷḷa uṟaiyiṉ aḻaṟci.

peripheral : puṟa uṟuppukaḷ; puṟa; puṟattiya; veḷippuṟa : or uṟuppiṉ allatu uṭaliṉ puṟa uṟuppukaḷ cārnta.

peripheral nervous system : veḷinarampu maṇṭalam; puṟa narampu maṇṭalam.

peripheral polyneuritis : puṟa narampu cuḻaṟci.

peripheral tissue : puṟatticu.

periphery : puṟap parappu, puṟa ellai : 1. oru uṭaṟparappiṉ veḷippakuti. 2 maiyappakutiyiliruntu cellum vaḻippātai.

periphlebitis : ciraiccuṟṟaḻaṟci : oru ciraiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷ allatu ciraiyiṉ veḷiyuṟaiyaḻaṟci.

periportal : kallīral cūḻnta : kallīral ciraiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa.

periproctitis : kutavāy aḻaṟci; malakkuṭal vāy aḻaṟci; kutac cuṟṟaḻaṟci : malakkuṭalaiyum, kutavāyaiyum cuṟṟi ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

perirenai : ciṟunīrakam cūḻnta; ciṟunīrakattaic cuṟṟi; ciṟunīrakap puṟam : ciṟunīrakattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa.

perisalpingitis : karuppaik kuḻaṟcuṟṟaḻaṟci : ḵpellōppiyaṉ (karuppaik) kuḻalaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perisigmoiditis : vaḷaikuṭaluṟai aḻaṟci : peruṅkuṭaliṉ vaḷaivu maṭakkattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa, vayiṟṟuk kuḻiyuṟai aḻaṟci.

perisinusitis : ciraippai ticu aḻaṟci : oru paikkuḻi kuṟippāka mūṭṭu uṟaiyiṉ ciraippaiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perispermatitis : vintuvaṭac cuṟṟaḻaṟci : vintuvaṭattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perisplanchnitis : uḷḷuṟuppuc cuṟṟaḻaṟci : uḷḷuṟuppukkaḷaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perisplenitis : maṇṇīral uṟaiyaḻaṟci; maṇṇīral cuṟṟaḻaṟci : maṇṇiralilum ataiyaṭuttu kaṭṭamaivukaḷilum uḷḷa uṟaikaḷil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam. peristalsis : vayiṟṟuc tacai iyakkam; kuṭal alaivu; kuṭal tacai alaivu; alaiviyakkam : kuṭaliluḷḷa poruḷkaḷ vayiṟu neṭukilum nakarntu cellum vakaiyil kuṭalil ēṟpaṭum acaiviyakkam oru tacait taḷarvu alaiyait toṭarntu inta acaivu alaivu tōṉṟum. uṇavuc cāram eḷitil celvataṟku icaivāka uṇarvaṟṟa vaṭṭākāramāṉa taṉṉiyakkat tacaic curukka alaikaḷ uṇṭākum.

peritectomy : maraipaṭala nīkkam : maraipaṭalattai cariceyvataṟkāka, paḷiṅkuppaṭalattaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa viḻiveṇ(yiṇaip) paṭalam pakutiyai aṟuttu nīkkutal.

peritendineum : tacaināṇ uṟai : tacaināṇ iḻaikaḷukkiṭaiyē nīḷum, tacai nāṇkaḷai cūḻntuḷḷa nāṇiḻai uṟaikaḷil oṉṟu.

perithyroiditis : tairāyiṭu cuṟṟaḻacci : tairāyiṭu curappiyaic cūḻntuḷḷa uṟai allatu ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

peritomy : imaiyiṇaip paṭala aṟuvai; cuṟṟu veṭṭu : kaṇṇiṉ karuviḻip paṭalam curuṅkiviṭāmal taṭukka karuviḻip paṭalattiṉ viḷimpiluḷḷa imaiyiṇaip paṭalattiṉ oru pakutiyai veṭṭiyeṭuttal.

peritoneum : vayiṟṟu uṟuppu uṟai (vapai); utara uṟai; vayiṟṟuḷḷuṟai : aṭivayiṟṟu uṭpakutiyaic cūḻntuḷḷa nīraṭaṅkiya iraṭṭaiccavvuppai.

peritoneoscope : vayiṟṟukkuḻivaṟai nōkki : oru muṉaiyil oḷiyaiyum maṟumuṉaiyil pārvai villaiyaiyum koṇṭa oru melliya nīḷamāṉa aka nōkki, vayiṟṟuc cuvaril oru ciṟukīṟal ceyvataṉ mūlam vayiṟṟuk kuḻivaṟaiyaip pārvaiyiṭa utavi ceykiṟatu.

peritoneoscopy : vayiṟṟukkuḻivaṟai nōkkal : vayiṟṟuc cuvar ūṭāka oru vayiṟṟuk kuḻivaṟai nōkkik koṇṭu vayiṟṟu uḷḷuṟaik kuḻivaṟaikkuḷ aṭaṅkiya uṟuppukaḷaip paricōtittal.

peritoneotomy : vayiṟṟuḷḷuṟai veṭṭu : vayiṟṟu uḷḷuṟaiyai aṟuttal.

peritoneovenous : vayiṟṟuḷḷuṟaic ciraiya : vayiṟṟuḷḷuṟaik kuḻivaraikkum cirai maṇṭalattukkumuḷḷa iṇaittoṭarpu.

peritonitis : vapai aḻaṟci; vayiṟṟaṟai uṟai aḻaṟci; utarap paiyuṟai aḻaṟci : vayiṟṟu uṟuppu uṟaiyil (vapai) ēṟpaṭum vīkkam. peritonsiilar abscess (quinsy) : toṇṭaic catai aḻaṟci; toṇṭaic catai cuṟṟuc cīḻkkaṭṭi; toṇṭai vīkkam; uḷnākkup paḻuppu : toṇṭaic cataiyilum, ataic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa nekiḻvāṉa ticukkaḷilum ēṟpaṭum kaṭum aḻaṟci.

peritrichous : periṭrikōs : cuṟṟiḻai koṇṭa taṉatu veḷip parappu muḻuvatilum iḻaikaḷai allatu kacaiyiḻaikaḷaik koṇṭa nuṇ uyir.

perityphlitis : kuṭalvāl aḻaṟci.

periumbilical : toppuḷ cūḻnta; unticcuṟṟu : toppuḷaic kaṟṟiyuḷḷa.

periurethritis : ciṟunīrttāraic cuṟṟaḻaṟci : ciṟunīrttāraiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perivascular : kuruti nāḷam cūḻnta; kurutik kuḻāykc cūḻal : oru kurutināḷattaic cuṟṟi uḷḷa.

perleche : utaṭu nakkutal; kōṭṭu vāyppuṇ : utaṭu citai vuṟutal, utaṭṭil porukkup paṭartal kāraṇamāka utaṭṭai nākkāl nakkik koṇṭiruttal. itu teṟṟup pal, pākṭīriyā nōy, vaiṭṭa miṉ paṟṟākkuṟai, kai cūpputal kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭalām.

perivasculitis : nāḷaccuṟṟaḻaṟci : oru kuruti nāḷattai cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉ aḻaṟci.

perlingual : nāvaḻi : nākku vaḻiyāka maruntaic celuttutal.

permeable : ūṭuruva iṭam tarum : karaicaliluḷḷa poruḷ allatu nīrmaṅkaḷ ūṭucella aṉumatikkum.

permeability : ūṭuruvum taṉmai; ūṭuruvu tiṟaṉ; ūṭiyalpu : uṭal tiravaṅkaḷil karaintu uḷḷa poruḷkaḷ uyiraṇukkaḷiṉ iḻaimaṅkaḷiṉ allatu uyiraṇup paṭalaṅkaḷiṉ vaḻiyē enta aḷavukku ūṭuruvic cellakkūṭiyavai eṉṟa tiṟaṉ.

permeation : ūṭuruval : oru uṟuppu, ticu allatu veḷi ūṭuruvip paravutal.

pernicious anaemia : kṭuṅ kurutic cōkai; uyir pōkkum kuruticcōkai; koṭuñcōkai : maraṇam viḷaivikkakkūṭiya kaṭumaiyāṉa kurutic cōkai nōy.

perniosis : kuḷirpparu : kaṭuṅkuḷir kāraṇamāka uṇṭākum tōl pātippu. kuḷirpaṭum pōtu tacaic curippu ēṟpaṭṭu itu uṇṭākum.

perobrachius : kaiūṉam : piṟaviyiliruntē muṉkaikaḷ ūṉamuṟṟa oruvar.

perochirus : viraṟkuṟai : piṟaviyiliruntē kai viralkaḷ allatu kāl viralkaḷ ūṉamuṟṟa oruvar.

perocormus : uṭaṟkuṟai : piṟaviyiliruntē uṭaṟpakuti ūṉamuṟṟa oruvar.

perodactylus : piraṟkuṟai : piṟaviyiliruntē kai viralkaḷ allatu kālviralkaḷ ūṉamuṟṟa oruvar.

peroidin : perāyṭiṉ : poṭṭāciyam perkkuḷōrēṭ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

perora : vāyvaḻiyē : ciṟu kuṭal uyirpporuḷ āyvu pōṉṟu vāyvaḻi āyvu.

﻿Q



Q band : kyūpaṭṭai : oḷirum niṟapporuḷāṉa kviṉākriṉ koṇṭu iṉakkīṟṟukaḷ niṟa mēṟṟappaṭumpōtu kuṟip piṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil tōṉṟum oḷirum paṭṭaikaḷ, ṭi.eṉ.ē, curuḷukkuḷ cerukukiṉṟaṉa.

Q fever : kiyū-kāyccal : āṭu māṭukaḷiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkut toṟṟum oruvakaik kāyccal nōy.

QRS complex : kyūāres tokuti : itaya miṉ varai paṭattil oru pakuti. itayak kīḻaṟaikaḷāṉa veṉṭrikkiḷ kaḷ curuṅkumpōtu tōṉṟum pakuti mutalil tōṉṟum etirmiṉ tiruppam kyū, aṭuttu nērmiṉ tiruppattāl mēl nōkkiya alai ār, toṭarntu varum etirmiṉ tiruppam es ākum.

QRS interval : kyūāres iṭai nēram : itayakkīḻaṟaiyāṉa veṉṭrikkiḷkaḷiṉ miṉ muṉaippiyakkam māṟum nēram. itu itaya miṉ varai paṭattil kyū allatu vaṅkuvatiliruntu es alai muṭiyum varaiyuḷḷa nēram. itaṉ carācari aḷavu 0.04 vināṭi mutal 0.1 vināṭi varai

QS wave : kyūes alai : itayamiṉ varaipaṭattil nēramai ār illāta muḻuvatum etir (miṉ tiruppa) alai maṭṭum koṇṭa kyūāres tokuti.

QT interval : kyūṭī iṭainēram : itayamiṉ varaipaṭattil itayakkīḻaṟai curuṅkum nēram, kyū allatu vaṅkuvatu mutal ṭī alai muṭivu varai kaṇakkiṭappaṭukiṟatu. itu itayamiṉ oṭṭa mukappu mīḷ tiruppattaik kuṟikkiṟatu.

quack : pōli maruttuvaṉ; pōli aṟuvaiyāḷar; arai kuṟai maruttuvam : maruttuva aṟivō, paṭṭaṟivō illāmal, iruppatupōl naṭikkum oruttaṉ.

quackery : pōli maruttuvam : oru nōy nilaikku kuṇam tarum poruḷ, karuvi, allatu maruttuva muṟai eṉa poyyākak kūṟutal.

quadrantanopsia : kāṟkuruṭa : kāṟ pārvaiyiṉmai.

quadpack : nāṉmaṭippai : (nāṉkupaiyamaippu) kuḻantaikaḷukku kurutiyēṟṟam ceyya ētuvāṉa iratta cēmippu piḷāsṭik pai, veḷippaikaḷ mūṉṟu koṇṭatu. kirumi pukā vakaiyil 500 mi.li. muḻu irattattai cēmittu atai nāṉku 1. pakutikaḷākap pirittuvaikka utavukiṟatu.

quadrate : nakōṇa elumpu:

quadriceps : nāṉku talait tacaikaḷ : toṭaiyiluḷḷa nīṭṭat tacaiyiṉ nāṉku talaittacaikaḷ. itu nāṉku pakutikaḷaik koṇṭatu.

quadrigeminal; quarigeminal : nāḷ mukaikaḷ : narampaṇukkaḷ kuviyap peṟṟa naṭu mūḷaiyiṉ nāṉku mēṭukaḷ.

quadrigeminal pulse : nāṟṟuṭi nāṭi : nāṉku tuṭippum oru iṭai veḷiyum uḷḷa nāṭi vakai.

quadripara (quartipara) : nāṉkām karuttarippu : nālupeṟṟa peṇ nāṉkumuṟai karuttarittu nālu uyiruḷḷa kuḻantaikaḷaip peṟṟeṭutta peṇ.

quadruped : nāṟkāl vilaṅku : nāṉku kālkaḷaiyuṭaiya vilaṅku kaikaḷaiyum kālkaḷaiyum taraiyil ūṉṟiya nilai.

quadruple vaccine : nāṟkūṭṭu; maṭaṅku ammaippāl : toṇṭai aṭaippāṉ, kakkuvāṉ, iḷampiḷḷai vātam, vilvāta caṉṉi ākiya nōykaḷukku etirāka nōyt taṭuppu ceyvataṟkāṉa ammaip pāl maruntu.

qualitative : paṇpu cārnta; paṇputtiṟaṉ : paṇpu aṭippaṭai yilāṉa paṇpu toṭarpāṉa.

quality : taram : paṇpu.

quantimeter : aḷavumāṉi : oruvarukku enta aḷavu eks katirkaḷiṉ tākkam uḷḷatu eṉṟu kaṇikkum karuvi

Quarantine : toṟṟut taṭaik kāppu; otukkuk kaṇkāṇippu : aṭaimaṉai nōyāḷiyai taṉimaippaṭuttal payaṇikaḷ, kappal nōyāḷikaḷ ākiyōrait toṟṟut taṭaik kāppukkāka taṉimaiyil vaikkum kāla aḷavu.

quarantine international : pēraṭaimaṉai : paṉṉāṭṭu aṭaimaṉai.

quartan : nāṉku nāḷ muṟaik kāyccal : nāṉku nāṭkaḷukku orumuṟai varum kāyccaluṭaṉ kūṭiya valippu nōy.

quaternary : nāṟtaṉima : 1. varicaiyil nāṉkāvatu. 2. nāṉku taṉimaṅkaḷ allatu nāṉku aṇukkaḷ cērnta oru vētiyiyal poruḷ.

Quenu-Mayo operation : kuveṇu-mēyō aṟuvai : ḵpireñcu aṟuvai maruttuvar kkuveṇuvum amerikka aṟuvai maruttuvar mēyōvum cērntu kaṇṭupiṭitta aṟuvai maruttuva puṟṟu nōyai kuṇappaṭutta nērkkuṭalaiyum cuṟṟiyuḷḷa niṇakkaṇukkaḷaiyum veṭṭi yeṭuttal.

questran : kuvasṭirāṉ : elumiccai maṇamuṭaiya kolas ṭrirāmiṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

Quick's test : kuvikcōtaṉai : oru paṭinilai purōtrāmpiṉ cōtaṉai. amerikka maruttuvar ārmāṉṭ viḷakkiya cōtaṉaiyil tīrām pōpiḷāsṭiṉ maṟṟum kālciyam cērttapiṉ irattam uṟaivataṟkāṉa nēram.

Quick tourniquet test : kuvikṭurṉikkēṭ cōtaṉai : mēṟkaiyil iratta aḻuttakkaṭṭup paṭṭaiyai kaṭṭuvataṉ mūlam tōṉṟum karuñciṟuppu tōṟ puḷḷikaḷaik kaṇakkiṭum cōtaṉai mēṟkaiyil iratta oṭṭam taṭaipaṭumpōtu tantukikaḷiṉ valuviṉmaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭikkum cōtaṉai.

Quiescent : amaitiyāṉa acaiviṉmai : oru nōy aṭaṅkik kiṭakkum nilai; kuṟippāka oru tōlnōy ivvāṟu irukkum amaitik kālam.

quinacrine : kuviṉēkriṉ : nāṭāppuḻunōy, nūlpuḻu nōy maruttuvam maṟṟum malēriyāvai kaṭṭuppaṭuttum maruttuvattukkum payaṉpaṭuttap paṭum kārvakai maruntup poruḷ.

quinalbarbitone : koyṉal pārpiṭṭōṉ : kuṟukiya kālam ceyaṟpaṭum oruvakaip pārpiṭṭurēṭ ilēcāṉa uṟakkamiṉmai, maṉakkavalai nilaikaḷil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

quinapril : kuviṉāpril : āñciyōṭeṉciṉ maṟṟum noti taṭuppu (ēciī iṉhipiṭṭar) eṉṉum vakai cārnta kuruti aḻuttattukkāṉa maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum maruntu.

Quincke's puise : kuviṉk(kē) nāṭi; tantuki nāṭi : itaya ayōḷarṭṭik vālv ceyal paṭā nilaiyil, nakappaṭukaiyil tantukip parappukaḷ veḷiṟiyum civantum māṟimāṟit tōṉṟum nilai.

quinestrol : ceyaṟkai peṇpāl iyakkunīr : ceyaṟkaiyāṉa peṇpāliṉa iyakkunīr (hārmōṉ). itu pāl curappatai maṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟatu.

quinoline : kuviṉōliṉ : kāyccal etirppu maṟṟum kirumi nīkka kuṇaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa kviṉiṉ allatu kari eṇṇaiyiliruntu peṟappaṭṭa kāra vakaip poruḷ.

quirk : kuyirk : vintaiyāṉa ceyal, naṭattai, āḷumai, ēyppuc ceyal, coṟpuraṭṭu.

qunidine : koyiṉiṭiṉ : koyiṉā pōṉṟa veṭiyak kalappuṭaiya oru vētiyiyal mūlapporuḷ (kārakam). itu itayat tamaṉit tacaiyil taṉi viḷaiviṉai uṇṭupaṇṇukiṟatu. cila camayam tamaṉi nāriḻai yākkattilum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

quinine : koyiṉā : ciṉkōṉāp paṭṭaiyiluḷḷa kārakap poruḷ ciṅkōṉāppaṭṭaik kārakamaṭaṅkiya maruntu. oru camayam, muṟaik kāyccalukkup (malēriyā) payaṉpaṭuttap paṭṭatu. piṉṉar itaṟkup patilāka vēṟu maruntukaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭalāyiṉa. inta maruntukaḷukku etirāka muṟaik kāyccal etirppu āṟṟal peṟṟuviṭṭatāl, ippōtu itu mīṇṭum payaṉpaṭuttap paṭṭu varukiṟatu.

quininism : koyiṉā nōy : talaivali, kātukaḷil ocaikaḷ eḻutal, oraḷavu ceviṭṭut taṉmai kaṇpārvaikkōḷāṟu: kumaṭṭal pōṉṟa nōyk kuṟikaḷ tōṉṟutal koyiṉāvai toṭarntu payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl ivai ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

quinsy : toṇṭai vīkkam; toṇṭai cīḻkkaṭṭi : uḷ nākkup paḻuppu uḷ nākku aḻaṟci.

quotidian : nāḷ muṟaic caṉṉi : nāḷtōṟum viṭāmal varum kāyccal.

quotient : īvu : vakuttu vanta eṇ. aṟivukkuṟi eṇ eṉpatu aṟivuttiṟaṉ aḷaveṇ. cuvāca īvu eṉpatu, oru kuṟippiṭṭa kāla aḷaviṉ pōtu uḷḷiḻukkum ākcijaṉ aḷavukkum, veḷiviṭum kārpaṉṭai-yākcaiṭiṉ aḷavukkum iṭaiyilāṉa vikitam.

Q wave : kuyū alai : itayamiṉ varai paṭattil ār alaikku muṉ tōṉṟum oru ciṟiya etir miṉ tiruppam iṭatu kīḻaṟaiyiliruntu valatu kīḻaṟaikkum kīḻaṟaiyiṭait taṭuppuc cuvar vaḻi ēṟpaṭum iyakkam.





﻿radiculography : vēr ūṭu katirppaṭam : mutukantaṇṭu narampu vērkaḷ ūṭukatir (eksrē) paṭam. inta vērkaḷaik katir ūṭuruvātavāṟu ceytu, anta vērkaḷiṉ ūṭu katirppaṭam eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. nekiḻcciyaṭainta iṭai mutukelumpu vaṭṭac cilliṉ iṭattaiyum, aḷavaiyum kaṇṭaṟiya ippaṭam eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu.

radioactive : katiriyakkapporuḷ; katiriyakka : aṇukkaru maiyam uṟutiyaṟṟiruppatāl veppak katirkaḷaivīcakkūṭiya poruḷ. nuraiyīral nōykaḷai ārāya katiriyakkat taṅkam payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu. kēṭayac curappiyil (tairāyṭu) katiriyakka ayōṭiṉ irukkiṟatu. itaṉai aḷaviṭṭu aṟiyalām.

radiobiology : katiriyakka uyiriyal : uyiruḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉmītu katiriyakkattiṉ viḷaivukaḷai ārāyum aṟiviyal.

radiocaesium : katiriyakka cīciyam : cīciyam eṉṟa taṉimattiṉ katiriyakkat taṉmai koṇṭa oru vaṭivam; itu, nōykaḷukkāṉa katiriyakka maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

radiocarbon : katiriyakka kārpaṉ : kārpaṉ (kariyam) eṉṟa taṉimattiṉ katiriyakka vaṭivam. itu, vaḷarcitai māṟṟam paṟṟiya ārāycciyil payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

radiogram : ūṭukatir oḷippaṭam.

radiograph : ūṭukatir paṭam; ūṭukatir varaipaṭam; katir varai paṭam : ūṭukatir (eks-rē) oḷippaṭam. ūṭukatirkaḷaik koṇṭu oḷippaṭam eṭuttal.

radiographer : ūṭukatir vallunar; ūṭu katirppaṭap pativāḷar; katir varaivāḷar : ūṭukatir (eks-rē) nōykaḷaik kaṇṭaṟivatilum, nōy maruttuvattilum takuti peṟṟa vallunar.

radiography : katir viraiviyal; katir vīccu oḷippaṭa varaivi; ūṭu katirp paṭameṭuppu; ūṭu katiriyam : nōykaḷaik kaṇṭaṟiya ūṭukatir (eks-rē) oḷippaṭam eṭuttal; maruttuva ālōcaṉaippaṭi, ukkiramāṉa nōykaḷukku ūṭukatiraip payaṉ paṭutti maruttuvam ceytal.

radioiodinated human serum albumin (RIHSA) : katiriyakka ayōṭiṉēṟṟiya kuruti niṇanīrk karuppuratam : mūḷai naivukaḷaik kaṇṭaṟivataṟkum, irattam maṟṟum kurutinīr aḷavukaḷaik kaṇṭaṟivataṟkum, cuṟṟōṭṭa nēram, itaya veḷippāṭu ākiyavaṟṟai aḷaviṭuvataṟkum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. radioisotope : katiriyakka ōrakat taṉimam : orē aṇu eṇṇuṭaṉ vevvēṟu poruṇmai eṇkaḷ (eṭai) koṇṭa oru taṉimattiṉ vaṭivaṅkaḷ katiriyakka orakat taṉima nuṇṇāyvu mūlam oru kuṟippiṭṭa uṟuppil katiriyakka ōrakat taṉimam uḷḷatā eṉpataiyum, ataṉ aḷavaiyam kaṇṭaṟiyalām.

radiologist : ūṭukatir-katiriyakka maruttuvar; katiriyalār : ūṭu katir (eks-rē) maṟṟum atu pōṉṟa urukkāṭci uttikaḷaip payaṉpaṭutti nōykaḷaik kaṇṭaṟiyum maruttuva vallunar.

radiology : ūṭukatir-katiriyakka maruttuvam; katir vīcciyil; katiriyal : ūṭukatirkaḷaiyum, atu pōṉṟa urukkāṭci uttikaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭutti nōykkuṟikaḷaik kaṇṭaṟital.

x-ray photograph : ūṭukatir oḷippaṭam : elumpu mutaliyavaṟṟai ūṭukatir (eksrē) mūlam oḷippaṭam eṭuttal.

x-rays short wavelength : ūṭu katirc ciṟṟalai nīḷam : miṉṉiyal karuviyiṉāl uṇṭākkappaṭum miṉkānta ūṭakattiṉ ūṭuruvum katirkaḷ. potuvāka itu ūṭukatirp paṭaṅkaḷaik kuṟikkiṟatu.

X wave : eks alai : itayak kīḻaṟai curukkattiṉ pōtu mūvitaḻ vālvu kīḻ iṭam māṟuvatālum mēlaṟai viri vaṭaivatālum kaḻuttuc cirai aḻutta alai kīḻiṟaṅkutal.

xylene : cailīṉ : eḷitil tīppaṟṟakkūṭiya teḷivāṉa tiravam peṉcīṉaippōṉṟatu. pēṉ nōykkuk kaḷimpu maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

xylocaine : cailōkēyṉ : uṟuppellai uṇarvu nīkkum likṉōkkēyṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

xylo : sailō : maram toṭarpāṉakūṭum āṅkilac col.

xylol : cailōl : pēṉ nōykkup payaṉpaṭum cailiṉ eṉṟa kaḷimpu maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

xylometazoline : cailōmeṭ ṭācōliṉ : mūkkuk kuruti nāḷa iṟukka maruntu viraivākak kuṇamaḷikkum; āṉāl kuṟukiya kālamē viṉai purikiṟatu. aṭikkaṭip payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl mūkkaṭaippu uṇṭākum.

xylose : cailōs : maraccarkkarai.

xylose test : cailōs cōṉai : uḷḷīrppuk kēṭāṉa nōyaik kaṇṭaṟivataṟkāṉa cōtaṉai. itil, cailōs vāyvaḻi koṭukkappaṭṭu, atu ciṟunīril veḷiyēṟum. aḷavu aḷaviṭappaṭukiṟatu. ciṟunīril cailōs veḷiyēṟum aḷavu 25 viḻukkāṭṭiṟkuk kuṟaivāka irukkumāṉāl, uḷḷirppuk kēṭu irukkiṟatu eṉa aṟiyappaṭukiṟatu.

xylosuria : kiḷailōs ciṟunīr : ciṟunīril kiḷailōs kāṇappaṭutal.

xylotherapy : maramaruttuvam : uṭalil cila maraṅkaḷaip payaṉpaṭutti maruttuvam ceytal.

xylotox : cailōṭāks : uṟuppellai uṇarvu nīkkuplikṉōkkēyṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

xyrospasm: katticcurippu : nāvitarkaḷil kāṇappaṭum kaikaḷ viralkaḷai pātikkum toḻil toṭarpāṉa karippu.

xysma : cavvuttuṇukku : malap poruḷil kāṇappaṭum cavvut tuṇukkukaḷ.

xyster : eṉparāvi : elumpu karaṇṭum karuvi. elumpukaḷai curaṇṭap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum oru aṟuvai maruttuvariṉ karam pōṉṟa karuvi.

yellow blood : mañcaḷ irattam : irattac civappaṇukkaḷ tiraḷ koṇṭa oru tokuti pāl mañcaḷ veṇmai niṟam koṇṭatu. atu nōykkirumikaḷ toṟṟiyuḷḷatai kāṇpippatāl payaṉpaṭuttak kūṭiyatu.

yellow cartilage : mañcaḷ kuruttelumpu : mēṟpotivuṟai yāṉa mañcaḷ niṟac curuṅki viriyum kuruttelumpu.

yellow fever (yellow jack) : mañcaḷ kāyccal : mañcaṭ kāmālaiyum karuniṟa vāntiyumuṭaiya mañcaḷ kāyccal nōy oruvakaikkocuvāl paravum vairas nōy. itaṉ viḷaivāka, ciṟu nīrakaṅkaḷum nuraiyīralum vayiṟum vīkkamaṭaiyum; tōl mañcaḷ niṟamākum karuniṟattil vāntiyeṭukkum mañcaḷ kāmālaiyum īral aḻaṟciyum ēṟpaṭum.

Yersinia : erciṉyā : aleksāṇṭar peyar koṇṭa, eṉṭirō pēkṭīriyākkaḷ kuṭumpattaic cērnta, iyakkamillā, uṟaipeṟā, nīḷvaṭṭa allatu kōlvaṭiva irumuṉai kirām cāyamēṟkā nuṇ kirumiyiṉam.

Yersin's serum : erciṉ kuruti nīr : svis nāṭṭu nuṇṇuyiriyalāḷar aleksāṉṭar erciṉ peyar koṇṭa piḷēk nōykketirāṉ kurutinīr.

Y fracture : oymuṟivu : oy vaṭiva kaṇṭiṭai muṟivu.

Y ligament : oy piṇaiyam : iṭuppu mūṭṭiṉ mēl maṟṟum muṉ pakutiyai mūṭiyuḷḷa, oy vaṭivappaṭṭaiyāṉa amaippu.

Y-linked : oy-toṭarpāṉa : oy kurōmōcamkaḷ ēntic cel lum marapaṇukkaḷ allatu avai kaṭattum nilaikaḷ allatu kuṇanalaṉkaḷai kuṟikkum.

yoke : piṇaippu : 1. iṇaikkum amaippu, 2. iraṇṭu amaippukaḷai iṇaikkum paḷḷam allatu mēṭu.

Yokohama asthma : yōkkahāmā āstmā : ṭōkkiyōviṉ tuṟaimuka nakaramāṉa yōkkahāmāvil nilavum mūṭupaṉiyāl tūṇṭappaṭum āstumā nilai.

yolk : mañcaḷ karu : muṭṭaiyil uḷḷa mañcaḷ karu.

yolk sac (yolk bag) : mañcaḷ karu : muṭṭai mañcaḷ karup potivu iḻaippai.

yomesan : yōmecāṉ : mutircciyaṭainta nāṭāp puḻuvai veḷiyēṟṟum niklōcāmaiṭu eṉṉum maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

Young-Helmboltz theory : yaṅhelmpōlṭs koḷkai : pārvai paṟṟiya viti. niṟam koṇṭa veḷiccam, vevvēṟu aḷavuḷḷa civappu, paccai, ūtā niṟaṅkaḷukku īṭāṉa mūṉṟu vakai kūmpukaḷait tuṇṭukiṟatu.

Yoon's rings : yūṉ vaḷaiyaṅkaḷ : vayiṟṟu uḷ nōkkik karuttaṭaimuṟaiyil karuppaik kuḻāykaḷai aṭaikkum vaḷaiyaṅkaḷ.

Yorkes-Bridges test : piṇaippukaḷ- pālaṅkaḷ cōtaṉai : aṟivukkūrmaiyai cōtikkap payaṉpaṭum piṉeṭ cōtaṉai yil māṟṟiyamaittu naṉku amaitta vaṭivam.

Young's operation : yaṅ aṟuvaimuṟai : pālṭimōr ciṟunīr aṟuvai maruttuvar hiyūkyaṅ vivaritta pakuti purāsṭēr aṟuvai nīkkam.

Young's rule : yaṅ viti :āṅkila maruttuvar tāmas yaṅ uruvākkiya viti. oru kuḻantaikku tara aṟivuṟuttappaṭum maruntiṉ aḷavai kaṇakkiṭuvataṟkāṉatu. periyavarkaḷukkāṉa maruntaḷavai, vayatu āṇ peṇṇāl perukki varum kuḻantaiyiṉ vayatuṭaṉ paṉṉireṇṭiṉ eṇṇai kūṭṭut tokaiyāl vakuttāl kiṭaippatu.

Young's syndrome : yaṅ nōyiyam : āṇkaḷil virivaṭainta nuṇ mūccup pirikuḻalkaḷuṭaṉ cērntu, curappukaḷ kaṭṭiyāṉatāl viraimēviyil avai pāyvataṟkut taṭaiyēṟpaṭṭatāl kuṟainta eṇṇikkai vintaṇukkaḷ uḷḷa nilai. elumpuk kāṟṟil nuraiyīral kaḷiṉ mīḷ toṟṟukaḷ maṟṟum vintaṇu vilānilai tōṉṟukiṟatu. iḻai mayiriyakkaṅkaḷ iyalpāka uḷḷaṉa.

youth : iḷamai (kālam) : kuḻantaip paruvattukkum mutircciyaṭainta āḷnilaikkum iṭaiyiluḷḷa kālam.

Yo-yo effect : yō-yō viḷaivu : peruciṟunīrkkuḻal aṭaippiṉāl alaivuc curukkam pātikkappaṭṭatāl, virivaṭainta tuṇṭup pakutiyiṉ aṭippakutiyai aṭainta niṟap poruḷ perumpakuti cuḻaṟci muṟaiyil mēl ciṟunīrk kuḻalukkup piṉṉēṟuvatōṭu oru ciṟu pakuti, ciṟunīrppaikkuḷ celkiṟatu.

Yo-yo liver : yō-yō kallīral : oru vaḷarcitai māṟṟa viḷai poruḷ iṭaiyiṭaiyē cēmikkappaṭuvatāl kallīraliṉ aḷavu tiṭīreṉa peritāvatum ciṟitāvataṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa kārṉiṭṭiṉ kuṟainilai.

Y-plasty : oy cīraṟuvai : taḻumpuc curukkaṅkaḷaik kuṟaikka oy vaṭivak kīṟalaip payaṉpaṭuttutal.

Y-protein : oy-puratam : kallīral puratam iṇaipaṭāta pilirūpiṉuṭaṉ kallīral ticukkaḷil kaṭṭuppaṭum likāṇṭiṉ.

Y-set : oy-ceṭ : iraṇṭu taṉiyāṉa piḷāsṭik kuḻalkaḷ iraṇṭu nīrmapāṭṭilkaḷaic cērvatōṭu, mūṉṟu aḻukkikaḷum koṇṭa, oru iṇaippu coṭṭukkuḻalkaḷōṭu iṇaikkappaṭṭuḷḷa, oru mutaṉmai ciraiyūṭu toṭarpu vaḻiyāka, ciraiyūṭu nīrmaṅkaḷaic celuttap payaṉpaṭum, oru piḷāsṭik amaippu.

yttrium-90(90 y) : oyṭriyam-90 : katiriyakkap poruḷkaḷāl umiḻappaṭum "pīṭṭātukaḷkaḷ" eṉappaṭum etirmiṉmaṅkaḷai umiḻum poruḷ. 64h aḷavu araivāḻvuṭaiyatu. mārpakap puṟṟiṉpōtu itu elumpu meḻukil poruttappaṭukiṟatu.

Yuppie flu : yuppī ḵpḷūkāyccal : uṭalai nalivaṭaiyac ceyyum maṉa aḻuttam toṭarpāṉa vairas nōy.

Z-deformity : isaṭ urukkuṟai : rumaṭṭāyṭu mūṭṭaḻaṟciyil maṇikkaṭṭu veḷippakkam vilakiyum viralkaḷ uḷpakkam vilakiyuḷḷa nilai (taṭai tāṇṭuvōr ūrtiyilum naṭantum celvōr) peru viral. aṭikkaṭi aṇmaiya viralelumpukaḷ uḷḷaṅkaip pakkam naḻuval.

zebra body : sī(u)prā uṭalam : cila laicōcōmal cēmippu nōykaḷil kāṇappaṭum, akaṉṟa kuṟukkākak kuvinta maiyaliṉāyṭu paṭalaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa laicōcōm.

zebra pattern : varikkutirai pāṅku : pāṅku mayirtaṇṭil kantaka aḷavu kuṟaintiruppatāl, ṭirikkōskaisis viyātiyai, muṉaippaṭu oḷiyurup perukkiyil pārkkumpōtu, tōṉṟum māṟimāṟi veḷutta iruṇṭa paṭṭaikaḷ koṇṭa mayirt taṇṭu.

zeiosis : liyōcis : uṭkaru urukkulaivatōṭu maiṭṭōkāṉṭriyā vīkkamāka veḷippaṭum. niṇa aṇuvālāṉa uyiraṇu aḻippu vakai.

Zellballen : selpāleṉ : pakka narampumuṭiccuk kaṭṭiyil kāṇappaṭum, meṉmaiyāṉa kurutināḷa niṟaitticuvāl cūḻappaṭṭuḷḷa, vaṭṭa allatu palakōṇa mutaṉmai uyiraṇukkaḷ orē mātiri, valai mātiri kuviyalkaḷāy iruppatu.

zero : pūjyam : oṉṟum illai caiḵpar kuṟiyīṭu, varaipaṭattil naṭanilai uṟutip puḷḷi atiliruntu oru aḷavu kōliṉ ellā aḷavai pirivukaḷum aḷakkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. oru aḷavukōliṉ ippuḷḷiyiliruntu aḷavīṭu tuvaṅkukiṟatu. inta eṇ ulakukkaḷitta kuṟippiṭattakunta koṭaiyākum.

Zero-End Expiratory Pressure ZEEP : muṭivu pūjya veḷimūccu aḻuttam : mūccu veḷiyēṟum iṟutiyil kāṟṟu veḷiyēṟum aḷavukku tirumpum aḻuttam.

zero population growth : pūjya makkaḷtokai vaḷarcci : oru kuṟippiṭṭa kāla aḷavil piṟappukaḷiṉ eṇṇikkaiyum iṟappukaḷiṉ eṇṇikkaiyum camamāka irukkumpōtu makkaḷ tokaiyaḷavu kūṭuvatumillai, kuṟaivatumillai.

zestocautery : kotipputtīyppu : mikavum cūṭāṉa āviyai maruttuvattukku payaṉpaṭutta utavum karuvi.

zetacrit : sīṭṭākriṭ : hemaṭṭākriṭṭāl pātikkappaṭāta irattac cevvaṇu paṭivu vītattai tīrmāṉikkum muṟai. sīṭṭā paṭivu vītam, ḵpaipri ṉōjaṉ maṟṟum kāmmā ﻿kuḷōpuliṉ poṟuttavarai nērāṉatu.

Ziegler's operation : sīkḷer aṟuvaimuṟai : amerikka kaṇ maruttuvar sāmuvel sīkḷer vivaritta, oru ceyaṟkai kaṇmaṇiyai uruvākka vīvaṭivattil viḻik karumpaṭalattai veṭṭutal muṟai.

Ziehen's test : sīheṉcōtaṉai : jermaṉ narampiyalāḷar jerāksiheṉ vivaritta maṉa nala iyakka cōtaṉaiyil māṟupaṭṭa poruḷkaḷāṉa pūṉai, nāy iṭaiyē uḷḷa vēṟupāṭṭai vivarikka collum cōtaṉai.

Ziemann's dots : sīmāṉ puḷḷikaḷ : piḷāsmōṭiyam malēriyā kāyccalil cila camayam civappaṇup paṭalattil kāṇappaṭum ciṟu iḷañcivappuppuḷḷikaḷ.

Zieve's syndrome : sīvnōyiyam : mika atikamāka matu aruntum nōyāḷikaḷil nāṭpaṭṭa kallīral nōy uṇṭāki, iratta aḻivāl, vayiṟṟu valiyum, mañcaḷ kāmālaiyum, kurutikkoḻuppu mikaiyum uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa.

ZIFT : siḵpṭ : oru peṇṇiṉ karuppaik kuḻāyil karuvuṟṟa muṭṭaiyai ceyaṟkaiyāka vaippataṉ mūlam, makappēṟṟiṉmaiyai kuṇappaṭuttum muṟai. (karuvuṟṟa muṭṭaiyai karuppaikkuḻalukkuḷ celuttal).

zig-zag : vaḷaintu vaḷaintu : mutalil oru pakkamum aṭuttu maṟupakkamum kūrāṉa tiruppaṅkaḷai kāṇpikkum oru kōṭu nīḷutal.

zileuton : sīlilliyūṭṭāṉ : mitamāṉa naṭuttaramāṉa nāṭpaṭṭa āstumāvil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum oru 5 laippō āksiṉēs taṭuppi.

zinacef : liṉāceḵp : peṉiciliṉai etirkkum nuṇṇuyirikaḷukku etirākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum ceḵpurōkcim eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

zinamide : siṉāmaiṭu : kācanōyaik kuṇappaṭuttak koṭukkappaṭum pairāciṉā maiṭu eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

zinc : tuttunākam : palvēṟu cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷiṉ iṉṟiyamaiyāta paṅku vakikkum oru taṉimam. purata iṇaippil mukkiyap paṅku koḷkiṟatu. ālkakāl, karuttaṭai māttiraikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟāl itu kuṟaikiṟatu. tuttanākak kuṟaipāṭṭiṉāl,kurutic cōkai, kuḷḷa uruvam, maṇ tiṇṇum paḻakkam uṇṭākiṟatu.

zingiber : iñci : iñcik kiḻaṅku ceṭiyiṉ vēr.

Zinn's ligament : siṉpiṇaiyam : jermaṉ uṭaṟkūṟiyalāḷar jōṣaṉ si(2)ṉ peyar koṇṭa, kaṇṇiṉ nērttacaikaḷai iṇaikkum iṇaipput ticu.

zipper proglottid : sippar purōkuḷāṭṭiṭu : cēḵprōṉiṉ maṟṟum intiyamai celuttappaṭuvataṉ mūlam, nāṭāp puḻuviṉ pāluṟuppu mutirnta pakutiyil irukkum 15-20 veḷijip pōṉṟa kiḷaikaḷaik kāṭṭuvatu.

zirconium : sirkōṉiyam : 40ām eṇṇiluḷḷa aritāṉa ulōkat taṉimam. kuṟiyīṭu Zr.

z-lines : isṭkōṭukaḷ : itayattacai iḻaikaḷil varikaḷai kāṇpikkum kuṟukkukkōṭukaḷ.

zombie effect : sōmpī viḷaivu : kāraṇamillā pār(k)kiṉ caṉviyātiyaip pōṉṟa taṉmaikaḷ koṇṭa hēlō periṭāliṉ kūmpu veḷittaṭa viḷaivukaḷāl uṇṭākum āḷumai māṟṟaṅkaḷ.

zone : paṭṭai vaḷaiyam : pulam; kai kālkaḷait tāṅkum elumpuppaṭṭai vaḷaiyam.

Zondek's syndrome : sāṉṭek nōyiyam : jermaṉiyil piṟanta isrēl makappēṟu maruttuvar perṉ hārṭ sāṉṭek vivaritta nilaiyil piracavattukkup pintiya irattap pōkku, mikumulaippāl karappu, tairāyiṭumikai ākiyavai uḷḷaṉa.

zonesthesia : pakuti uṇarvu : vayiṟu allatu iṭuppaic cuṟṟi uṇarappaṭum, kuṟukkuvatu pōṉṟa valiyuṇarvu. -

zonifugal : pakuti nīṅkiya : oru pakuti, pirāntiyattiliruntu veḷippakkam nakarutal.

zoning phenomenon : pakutiyākka kāṭcimuṟai : maccai nāriya nōyil elumpu maccaiyil iyalpallā taṭṭaṉukkaḷ aṭukkappaṭṭiruttal elumpākkat tacaiyaḻaṟciyil elumpuk kuruttukaṭṭi pōṉṟa vaḷarcci mūṉṟu nuṇṇōkkiyap pakutikaḷāka uḷḷaṉa.

zonipetal : pakutineruṅkiya : oru pakuti allatu pirāntiyattai nōkki nakarutal.

zonisamide : sōṉicāmaiṭu : valippu etirppu maruntāṉa, ﻿peṉsicākssōl calḵpāṉamaiṭu.

zonked : pōtaiyēṟiya : maruntukaḷ allatu matuvāl mikavum naccūṭṭappaṭṭa.

zonoskeleton : pakuti elumpuk kūṭu : iṭuppelumpu, mutukuppaṭṭaiyelumpu, kāraiyelampu pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷ oṭṭum pakka elumpukaḷ.

zonula ciliaris : kaṇṇimai iḻaippiḻai : kaṇviḻiyāṭiyiṉ puṟappakutiyaik kaṇṇimai mayiruṭaṉ iṇaikkum toṅku iṇaippiḻai.

zonule : paṭṭai vaḷaiyam; ciṟu pakuti : ciṟupaṭṭai vaḷaiyam.

zonulolysis : kaṇṇimai iṇaippiḻai aḻaṟci; nuṇ pulamuṟivu : kaṇṇimai iḻaip piḻaiyil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

zoodermic : pirāṇittōl cārnta : tōl oṭṭaṟuvaiyil pōl pirāṇittōl koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa.

zooglea : oṭṭiya nuṇṇuyirkaḷ : ūṉpacaipporuḷāl patiyappaṭṭuḷḷa, nuṇṇuyirkaḷiṉ tokuti.

zoogony : uyirākkam : uṭalukkuḷḷiruntu, uyiruḷḷa iḷam uyir oṉṟai uruvākkutal.

zoograft : vilaṅkutticu oṭṭaṟuvai : oru kīḻnilai (pirāṇi) vilaṅkiliruntu ticuvai eṭuttu oṭṭaṟuvai.

zooid : vilaṅku pōṉṟa : oru vilaṅkuk kūṭṭattil oru uyir.

zoolagnia : vilaṅkuppāliṉa kavarcci : vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl pāliṉak kavarcci.

zoology : vilaṅkiyal : vilaṅkukaḷaip paṟṟik kūṟum uyiriyal viññāṉap pirivu.

zoomania : vilaṅku vēṭkai : vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl aḷavu mīṟiya viruppam.

zoonosis : tāvu nōy; vilaṅku vaḻi toṟṟu nōy; vilaṅkiya nōy : vilaṅkiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkut tāvakkūṭiya nōy, iṟaiccik koṭṭilkaḷ, paṇṇait toḻilāḷarkaḷ ākiyōrukku innōy uṇṭākum.

zoonotic helminths : vilaṅku ēntukuṭaṟpuḻukkaḷ : ṭiraik kiḷullāspairālis, ṭāksōkērā kēṉis, āṉkaki lōsṭōmāpirēsiliyeṉ cis, kṉētō sṭōmā vilaṅkukaḷāl maṉitarkaḷukkup paravum kuṭaṟ puḻukkaḷ. zoophilia : vilaṅku aṉpu : 1. vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl iyalpallā aṉpu, 2. pāliṉak kiḷarcciyai aṭaivataṟkāka, pāluṟavu allatu uṭaluṟavai virumputal.

zoospore : vilaṅkuk karumūlam : cila ōraṇuvuyirkaḷ, pūñcaikaḷ, pācikaḷ uruvākkum nakarum karuvaṇu.

zootoxin : vilaṅkunaccu :tēḷkaḷ, cilantikaḷ, pāmpukaḷiṉ viṣam pōṉṟa vilaṅkukaḷi liruntu uruvākum naccup poruḷ allatu atu mātiri nacciliruntu tayārikkappaṭum ūnīr.

z-plasty : isṭ oṭṭaṟuvai : taḻumpuc curukkaṅkaḷai iḷak kuvataṟku ceyyappaṭum vaṭiva maippu (cīr) aṟuvai isaṭ vaṭivil kīṟi, iru mukkōṇa maṭippukaḷai avaṟṟiṉ muṉaikaḷ curukkakkōṭṭai tāṇṭuvatu pōl iṭam peyartal.

zoster : tēmal : paṭar tāmarai, akki.

z protein : isṭ puratam : varit tacaiyiṉ isṭpaṭṭaiyil iyalpāka uḷḷa oru puratam.

z score : isṭkaṇippeṇ : kaṇippeṇṇukkum carācarikkum uḷḷa vēṟupāṭṭai oru nilaiyāṉa vilakalāl vakuppataik kuṟikkum matippeṇ vilakal.

z-track : isṭ taṭam : uḷ celuttappaṭṭa karaical piṉ varāmal taṭukkiṉṟa muṟaiyil uṭceluttum muṟai.

Zuckerkandl's bodies : sīkker kēṉṭil meymaṅkaḷ : jermaṉ uṭaṟkūṟiyalāḷar emilkkar kēṉṭil vivaritta, makātamaṉi iraṇṭākap piriyumiṭattiṟku arukiluḷḷa pakka narampu muṭiccu narampaṇut tiraḷkaḷ.

Zulu dancer's hip : sūlu naṭaṉamāṭuvōr iṭai : sūlu makkaḷil uṇṭākum toḻil maya mūṭṭaḻaṟci.

zvalue : isaṭ-matippu : oru makkaṭ kuḻuviṉ carācari kuṟippiṭṭa peṇṇiṭamiruntu māṟutal illai eṉṉum puṉaivu kōḷukkāṉa puḷḷi vivarac cōtaṉai.

z wave : isaṭ-alai : itaya mēlaṟai maṟṟum kīḻaṟaic curukkaṅkaḷukkiṭai nērattil mēlaṟai aḻuttam kuṟaital.

zwitterion : īrayaṉi : nērmiṉṉēṟṟamum etirmiṉṉēṟṟamum koṇṭa ayaṉi.

zygodactyly : viraluḷḷa : oṭṭi iṇainta viralkaḷaip pōli allāmal viralelumpukaḷiṉ elumpiṉaip piṇaippiṉṟi, tōl maṟṟum meṉticukkaḷāl oṭṭiyuḷḷa viralkaḷ.

zygogene cells : jaikōjīṉ aṇukkaḷ : pepsiṉ curakkum iraippai uyiraṇukkaḷ.

zygomaticus : kaṉṉakkatupput tacai : mēlutaṭṭai mēlākavum veḷippakkamum iḻukkum mukattacai. mukattiṉ iru pakkamum oru periyatum oru ciṟiyatumeṉa kaṉṉak katupput tacaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.

zygomycetes : oṭṭiṇaip pūñcai : etirppu caktiyiḻantavarkaḷil vaḷarum apciṭiṉ, miyūkār, raijōpas pōṉṟa pūñcaikkāḷāṉ) tokuti.

zygomycosis : oṭṭiṉai pūñcait toṟṟu : nōyāḷikaḷil tōṉṟum miyūkōrāciyē kuṭumpattai cērnta pūñcait toṟṟu. otutōlaṭit ticukkaḷ maṭṭumirukkakkūṭum allatu iratta nāḷaṅkaḷukkup paravakkūṭum.

zygosis : oṭṭukkaru : āṇ peṇpālaṇukkaḷiṉ (muṭṭaiyum vintaṇuvum) iṇaivatāl uṇṭākum karuvuṟṟa muṭṭai.

inta miṉṉūlaip paṟṟi


uṅkaḷukku immiṉṉūl, iṇaiya nūlakamāṉa, vikkimūlattil iruntu kiṭaittuḷḷatu[1].

inta iṇaiya nūlakam taṉṉārvalarkaḷāl vaḷarukiṟatu. vikkimūlam patiya taṉṉārvalarkaḷai varavēṟkiṟatu. tāṅkaḷum vikkimūlattil iṇaintu mēlum pala miṉṉūlkaḷai aṉaivarum paṭikkumāṟu ceyyalām.

mikunta akkaṟaiyuṭaṉ meyppu ceytālum, miṉṉūlil piḻai ētēṉum iruntāl tayakkam illāmal, vikkimūlattil immiṉṉūliṉ pēccu pakkattil terivikkalām allatu piḻaikaḷai nīṅkaḷē kūṭa cari ceyyalām.

ippaṭaippākkam, kaṭṭaṟṟa urimaṅkaḷōṭu (potukaḷa /kuṉu -Commons /GNU FDL )[2][3] ilavacamāka aḷikkappaṭukiṟatu. eṉavē, inta uraiyai nīṅkaḷ maṟṟavarōṭu pakiralām; māṟṟi mēmpaṭuttalām; vaṇika nōkkattōṭum, vaṇika nōkkamiṉṟiyum payaṉpaṭuttalām
